economy.zh: 过去24小时，全球市场被两股力量拉扯：一是地缘政治风险驱动的能源冲击，二是AI巨头财报引发的估值焦虑。美股方面，[Alphabet与Tesla的财报](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/22/alphabet-tesla-test-investor-patience-ai-spending-overshadows-growth.html)显示AI投入激增但增长乏力，拖累股价；与此同时，伊朗局势升级推高油价，[运输船只在霍尔木兹海峡遇袭](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/23/oil-prices-today-wti-brent-trump-iran-hormuz.html)后，特朗普威胁轰炸伊朗，能源市场面临结构性脆弱性。中国经济板块中，明星基金经理张坤[大幅减持消费股、转向AI](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3361544/chinas-star-fund-manager-dumps-long-held-consumer-bets-pivot-ai-trade)，折射出消费复苏低于预期；半导体公司Semight暴涨后[考虑赴港上市](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxQb01Ndmdlc1RyaFY3OTg1OXdMQlZKR3FPeUlvRlZQOWhnajZwT3FuLU5ET3R0QU04VWVqZFBWMHBnRnl1MTJRSk9hX0d0NkN5dXNqOHQwX1NBd1hfRjFZYzU5T3A2dVpacnBocl9ia044WmJvWVlkY3RoRUtMSFhwczlXeUpjMGlIX1hDcUVCRWJlNnNrb2NKd2RuWkZBY2stanQ1TGtlWEZJV1pVWWVLMUhpYk5kOG1ZVWxBWGxKT1c)，但A股科创50在半导体回调中跌超4%。欧洲方面，市场普遍预期[ECB将暂停加息但发出偏鹰信号](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxPWlVwWWR4ZHRJQnVaQjNuTEJYWmt6UkF1LWRDREFISGh0UDB3NjVBMkdaMmhaX2pTZkJYRk9aNTRLSjN5Skp3bWJLVFdObjJIMlZxM1ViRVhUZ09qS2Fuc2tPWVhUenBWOS14eVVOYVBDbXBYVVFHUmRhTkEtUUsydlJuQkZpTHh6cGpyOWtFM2Y4UU5UbEpocjREQjE)，能源价格上涨强化了紧缩压力；欧元走强反映了这种预期。国内社区层面，资金面分化显著：黄金、白银ETF加仓，而宽基ETF单日流出209亿元，显示避险情绪与获利了结并存。**后续观察**：周四ECB利率决议将是近期关键变量，若措辞偏鹰，可能进一步压制风险偏好；美伊冲突若持续升级，油价及航运成本对全球经济的影响将加速显现；中国AI赛道虽获资金流入，但需警惕估值泡沫与海外制裁风险。
economy.en:
Global markets are navigating a volatile mix of escalating US-Iran military tensions, mixed earnings from mega-cap tech, and anticipation of the ECB's next policy move. Oil prices surged after a tanker strike off Saudi Arabia, while Alphabet and Tesla shares fell on heavy AI spending. In China, a star fund manager's dramatic pivot from consumer to AI stocks underscores a shifting investment landscape, and the ECB is widely expected to pause rates but signal further tightening. The day's news points to a market increasingly driven by geopolitical risk premiums and a relentless AI capex cycle.

- **Oil prices jump on Strait of Hormuz threat**: [Oil prices climb](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/23/oil-prices-today-wti-brent-trump-iran-hormuz.html) after a tanker was struck off Saudi Arabia, with President Trump threatening to bomb Iranian infrastructure. Analysts warn that fuel prices will not fall quickly even if the shooting stops, due to asymmetric market dynamics. Separate coverage details the [diesel crisis](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/23/business/bangladesh-farmers-diesel-water-iran.html) threatening poor farmers globally.
- **Tesla and Alphabet test investor patience on AI spending**: [Tesla misses earnings](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/22/tesla-tsla-q2-2026-earnings-report.html) as free cash flow turns negative and margins slide. [Alphabet also dips](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/22/alphabet-tesla-test-investor-patience-ai-spending-overshadows-growth.html) after reporting massive AI spending increases. Yet some analysts argue for [sticking with Alphabet](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/22/why-were-sticking-with-alphabet-despite-an-imperfect-quarter-and-more-ai-spending.html) despite the imperfect quarter.
- **China's star fund manager dumps consumer stocks for AI**: [Zhang Kun](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3361544/chinas-star-fund-manager-dumps-long-held-consumer-bets-pivot-ai-trade) of E Fund Blue Chip Selected slashed holdings in liquor and e-commerce to rotate into AI-linked names, reflecting tepid consumer spending and the rise of AI as the dominant narrative.
- **Semight mulls Hong Kong IPO after 2,200% surge**: [China’s Semight](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxQb01Ndmdlc1RyaFY3OTg1OXdMQlZKR3FPeUlvRlZQOWhnajZwT3FuLU5ET3R0QU04VWVqZFBWMHBnRnl1MTJRSk9hX0d0NkN5dXNqOHQwX1NBd1hfRjFZYzU5T3A2dVpacnBocl9ia044WmJvWVlkY3RoRUtMSFhwczlXeUpjMGlIX1hDcUVCRWJlNnNrb2NKd2RuWkZBY2stanQ1TGtlWEZJV1pVWWVLMUhpYk5kOG1ZVWxBWGxKT1c) is said to consider a Hong Kong listing after a remarkable 2,200% stock rise, highlighting demand for Chinese chip names.
- **ECB set to pause but keep hawkish bias**: [Reports](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxPWlVwWWR4ZHRJQnVaQjNuTEJYWmt6UkF1LWRDREFISGh0UDB3NjVBMkdaMmhaX2pTZkJYRk9aNTRLSjN5Skp3bWJLVFdObjJIMlZxM1ViRVhUZ09qS2Fuc2tPWVhUenBWOS14eVVOYVBDbXBYVVFHUmRhTkEtUUsydlJuQkZpTHh6cGpyOWtFM2Y4UU5UbEpocjREQjE) indicate the ECB will pause rate hikes but signal more may be needed. The euro is firming ahead of the decision, with energy prices adding to inflation concerns.
- **India's 'Cockroach party' protests challenge Modi**: A [Gen Z protest](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/23/gen-z-protest-india-cockroach-modi-leadership.html) movement organized by the Cockroach Janta Party is gaining momentum, testing political stability.
- **Hong Kong's offshore yuan market evolves**: [Bloomberg reports](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxNdzlQT1UyVkV0ZmxHRUNINmNQSFVFMW1HeHUzb2xlQjZwcEQ2QkRkT2h0dXhZWjlma2RVbnpXOE5VdnNSM2wwZkt0QkItdTBSc2NKRW9QQ19qeDF3YWpMU1o2WmN5RjhqMXNUaDJYc0dubzJnSXFGWWlRcFA3M0xNeVNlVzJRTDYyeDFjZmpCVnhjc3QxWl9SdUtXUVRXemp3eDNZQ3k2aU9jTTJBRTB1Vzg5dldTUQ) that Hong Kong's offshore yuan market is maturing into a global funding hub, a key development for China's internationalization efforts.
- **Secret Service warns of highest threat environment**: A [US Secret Service official](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/22/secret-service-threat-trump-white-house-drones.html) reports a 40% increase in threats to protectees, including President Trump, adding to overall market uncertainty.

**Watch next**: The ECB rate decision (Thursday) will set the tone for European markets and the euro. US-Iran further escalation could push oil above recent highs. Earnings season continues, with focus on whether AI spending will continue to weigh on tech stocks or eventually deliver returns.

society.zh: 今天的社会新闻呈现出一幅冲突与科技并行、地缘与民生交织的复杂图景。乌克兰无人机连续打击俄罗斯最大电商Wildberries仓库，冲突正从战场向商业基础设施蔓延；胡塞武装在宣布对沙特实施“海上封锁”后首次攻击油轮，红海航运面临新威胁。美国众议院以党派划线通过了1.15万亿美元的军事法案，扩大与以色列合作，但参议院前景未卜；与此同时美国与沙特签署历史性核协议，美国企业获准进入沙特核电市场。加拿大乳业被特朗普列为新关税三大理由之一，美加贸易摩擦升级。AI领域，Google预期AI投资支出高达1900亿美元，烧钱速度引发市场担忧。日本遭遇极端酷热天气，电价创三年新高，蝉鸣昼夜不息，社会应对能力受考验。中国方面，习近平对基础教育工作作出重要指示，强调扩优提质；低空经济分会成立，职业教育向新质生产力靠拢。知乎营收下滑23.6%，加速AI商业化探索，社区内“一个电话就能解决的事”等民生话题引发热议。后续观察：红海航运若持续受阻将冲击全球能源供应链；美沙核协议可能重塑中东力量平衡；AI投资回报周期仍是行业核心悬念。
society.en:
Today's social news landscape is sharply divided between escalating geopolitical conflicts and domestic socio-economic pressures. Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian retail infrastructure signal a new phase of economic warfare, while Houthi threats in the Red Sea disrupt global shipping. In the US, a record $1.15 trillion military bill passes the House, and a landmark nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia is signed. Japan grapples with a brutal heatwave and soaring electricity costs, China pushes educational reforms, and Zhihu's revenue decline forces a strategic AI pivot. These stories underscore a world grappling with resource competition, technological disruption, and institutional strain.

- **Ukraine targets Russian supply chains:** Ukrainian drones hit multiple Wildberries warehouses in days, straining Russia's largest online retailer. [Read more](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvg9n2y61w6o)
- **Houthis re-ignite Red Sea crisis:** First attacks on oil tankers since a maritime embargo on Saudi Arabia; tankers make sharp U-turns. [Details](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cn0n127lpzgo) | [Claim](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cpw9xzx9r4ko)
- **US House passes $1.15 trillion military bill:** Expands Israel cooperation, funds Iran war, faces Senate uncertainty. [Report](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/23/us-house-passes-1-15-trillion-military-bill-expanding-israel-cooperation)
- **Google's AI spending burns cash:** Company expects up to $190bn in AI investments; financial strain grows. [Analysis](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c235n47g8g8o)
- **Japan's heatwave and energy crunch:** Electricity prices hit 3-year high; 'brutally hot' threshold broken. [Heat](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE4ycUtzRm9FOXFHaWd0WkRMM2I1MmlFRkFFNGRlS3V0ZDFVUGNFNU56OTRZQ1NWQ1dISGJua05mcmNTWk8wNGNKc04zMl9XVVlUNjhCYTVMcUJ2WktXSElkOVlRZzFxZG5pa05ZY0cwQjQyYnNLYjU2NA) | [Prices](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxNZjVzWUZmdnZZR2RWR1A4RUdVQlFpN2JhVlFldVZLUkRwLVlnV1BiZFN3VHZLM2toeTlIc2RvV3JOTHlmaDV4VFRISDVOeVZ5UVNCbkhDT1RyT1pnRkg4ajBTOTJCQUdfR29HbTVzRjc4RmZVVER2a2VsZDNYYS1uUnZoZ2luRmxE)
- **China's education directive:** Xi Jinping calls for expansion and quality improvement in basic education. [Statement](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTFAyamZkR0RGVGVaOU1hRnE3Ym9zNXN1LVlPQzZEeEZKa0cwX3I2Y2ljb3pGR0owQUJrRVlUeEFJaElBOW5tanVjSnhyOVVBR3J3ZzFFSURJQ3lzU1U1M1kzLVdBdVdaUW8zU1VmWHJhZWRybVh0UkJCTTN3)
- **Zhihu revenue falls 23.6%:** CEO accelerates AI commercialization as community grapples with change. [Earnings](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ)

**Watch next:** The Red Sea shipping disruption is likely to escalate, testing global supply chains. The US Senate's fate of the military bill will signal bipartisan resolve on Iran. Australia's AI regulation push, cheered by OpenAI and Anthropic, could set a global precedent. Japan's heatwave may lead to power rationing, while China's education reforms will be closely watched for implementation details.

military.zh:
今日军事新闻聚焦三大冲突轴心：霍尔木兹海峡危机急剧升温，美国与伊朗的军事对峙从空袭延伸至海上能源封锁；乌克兰战场出现F-16首次空对空击杀与总司令换将的结构性变化；中国在台海、南海及东海同步推进军事压力，引发中美外交摩擦。以下为关键动态综述。

- **霍尔木兹海峡危机升级**：特朗普威胁“每遇伊朗攻击即摧毁一座桥梁或电厂”([Washington Post](https://news.google.))，胡塞武装开始攻击沙特油轮([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/houthis-now-attacking-saudi-oil-tankers-in-red-sea-major-energy-supply-implications))，美防长称已护送5亿桶石油通过阿曼湾([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/22/u-s-has-smuggled-up-to-500-million-barrels-of-oil-through-gulf-of-oman-hegseth-says))，但Politico指出空袭成效已达极限([Politico](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxOdGhlTnlHZDFXcGRXQ0k0bHZGSXBLTjJJdzBkR3J1WVJYd3VKSUJfYW9uZ2kxWUg1YXJxbjRlejZHbXVkVWtYMm9XUXVHUFlDeDhUMXV3b1lLX3k4TjI2MWlzMlhqLTREV3Z4eUpnM0FObUdrc1FxNzBDcDB4V2NTRg))。
- **乌克兰F-16首杀与总司令更迭**：美高级将领确认乌F-16击落俄Su-35S([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/ukrainian-f-16-scored-first-air-to-air-kill-against-a-russian-fighter-top-u-s-general))；泽连斯基任命“飞行BMP”德拉帕蒂为新总司令([Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/07/22/who-is-mykhailo-drapatyi-the-flying-bmp-who-now-leads-ukraines-military/))，背景是最大规模抗议。
- **中国在台海、南海加大施压**：解放军直升机与无人机首次同时越过台海中线进入管控区域([朝鲜日报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxOaWFGZWtCRzRpbE9yMUZEdXpUTGJLR2xaWjBzcjRMdkRFQzlDNE9DQ0JBUlo5VlZ2WXBwUWxRUEc0dzdDcXJqX0xNaEVrT2tJcUtPQW1qYkx2UXBxeWJ5MkdhQXVQREl2azQ1NldXUVpNalRFRm5ldXhzZm5EV1VoaWo0SlU1S2F6UXVF))；中菲在仁爱礁发生冲突([BBC](https://news.google.))；日本抗议中国驱逐舰在冲鸟礁附近实弹演习([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/22/japan-protests-chinese-destroyers-live-fire-drill-near-disputed-reef))。
- **美陆军首次在西太部署“暗鹰”高超音速导弹**：参加“勇敢之盾”演习，射程覆盖中国方向([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/22/u-s-army-deploys-hypersonic-missiles-in-range-of-china-during-exercise)，[Defence Industry Europe](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxNTXotNF8xX25IOUdjT3lTNVMzdTVyOThlVG83eWduSUhNTVFDS2xBenl0WkU0OWdPQm9tVU1weExMdjdub29uMlV4bWxzM2R2dmVyazZycFBPOGIxUDVySVJLOHp2V2tNNnRZMXNLRVRISU1Say1HQVVGZzRIa1FrVnZCV21mUk1HVzJwXzhLTkxQdEY2Qk03dDl1Vk95TU9OTkFoU2VPMkV3OHpiZFdHbzdWRHdVVkJuYm5vQXR4emk5S2RoTm53Rm1n))。
- **英军公布“Brontanax”无人作战飞机**：BAE系统在范堡罗航展揭晓其“协同作战飞机”(CCA)原型，标志着英国进入无人空战时代([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/brontanax-fighter-drone-is-the-uks-big-leap-into-collaborative-combat-aircraft)，[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/bae-systems-unveils-brontanax-autonomous-combat-aircraft/))。

**后续观察**：三大危机（伊朗、乌克兰、台海）在24小时内同时升温，且互相联动——霍尔木兹危机推高全球油价，影响乌克兰粮食海运安全；中美在印太的军事部署竞赛因高超音速武器和无人系统加速进入新阶段。值得关注的是，美国对伊朗的“逐次降级”策略面临空袭效能瓶颈，而中国在东盟外长会上坚持南海立场，同时以军事行动展示控制力。
military.en:
The global security landscape is dominated by escalating tensions in the Middle East, where the U.S.-Iran conflict intensifies around the Strait of Hormuz and Houthi attacks now target Saudi oil tankers, threatening energy supplies. Concurrently, the war in Ukraine sees a new commander-in-chief and a confirmed F-16 air-to-air kill, while Black Sea shipping remains a flashpoint. In the Indo-Pacific, China continues its assertive military posture with incursions near Taiwan and a live-fire drill near a disputed reef, drawing sharp U.S. and Japanese responses. Across all domains, new weapons systems—from hypersonics to unmanned combat aircraft—are reshaping military balances.

- **Middle East Crisis Deepens**: Trump threatens to destroy bridges or power plants for each Iranian attack on the Strait of Hormuz, as Houthis strike Saudi oil tankers in the Red Sea. The U.S. has moved up to 500 million barrels of oil through the Gulf of Oman under escort. [Trump strikes threats](https://news.google.) | [Houthi tanker attacks](https://www.twz.com/news-features/houthis-now-attacking-saudi-oil-tankers-in-red-sea-major-energy-supply-implications) | [Oil movement](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/22/u-s-has-smuggled-up-to-500-million-barrels-of-oil-through-gulf-of-oman-hegseth-says)

- **Ukraine War: Leadership Change and First Air Kill**: Ukraine appoints Mykhailo Drapatyi as new commander-in-chief amid protests. A Ukrainian F-16 scores its first air-to-air kill against a Russian Su-35S, confirmed by a top U.S. general. Ukraine also convenes an urgent UN Security Council meeting over Russian Black Sea shipping attacks. [Commander change](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/07/22/who-is-mykhailo-drapatyi-the-flying-bmp-who-now-leads-ukraines-military/) | [F-16 kill](https://www.twz.com/air/ukrainian-f-16-scored-first-air-to-air-kill-against-a-russian-fighter-top-u-s-general) | [UNSC meeting](https://news.google.)

- **China’s Military Assertiveness**: Chinese helicopters and UAVs crossed the Taiwan Strait median line for the first time simultaneously. Sino-Philippine vessels clashed near Second Thomas Shoal as U.S.-China talks were underway. Japan protested a Chinese destroyer live-fire drill near Okinotori Island. [Taiwan incursion](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxOaWFGZWtCRzRpbE9yMUZEdXpUTGJLR2xaWjBzcjRMdkRFQzlDNE9DQ0JBUlo5VlZ2WXBwUWxRUEc0dzdDcXJqX0xNaEVrT2tJcUtPQW1qYkx2UXBxeWJ5MkdhQXVQREl2azQ1NldXUVpNalRFRm5ldXhzZm5EV1VoaWo0SlU1S2F6UXVF) | [Clash with Philippines](https://news.google.) | [Japan protest](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/22/japan-protests-chinese-destroyers-live-fire-drill-near-disputed-reef)

- **Hypersonic and Unmanned Advances**: U.S. Army deployed Dark Eagle hypersonic missiles in the Western Pacific during Valiant Shield, putting them within range of China. The UK unveiled its Brontanax autonomous combat aircraft. Ukraine’s Skyfall introduced a faster drone interceptor. [Dark Eagle](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/22/u-s-army-deploys-hypersonic-missiles-in-range-of-china-during-exercise) | [Brontanax](https://www.twz.com/air/brontanax-fighter-drone-is-the-uks-big-leap-into-collaborative-combat-aircraft) | [Skyfall interceptor](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/ukraines-skyfall-unveils-new-drone-interceptor-to-strike-russian-shaheds-faster/)

- **U.S. Navy Programs and Global Arms**: The Navy selected the RAACM-ER low-cost cruise missile for the CHAOS program to arm allies. Raytheon secured a $1.8B extension for SPY-6 radars. USS Tripoli completed a six-month Indo-Pacific and Middle East deployment. [RAACM-ER](https://www.twz.com/sea/navy-picks-raacm-er-low-cost-cruise-missile-for-program-to-help-arm-allies) | [SPY-6](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/raytheon-us-navy-spy6-radar-contract-extension/) | [Tripoli](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/22/amphib-uss-tripoli-wraps-6-month-indo-pacific-middle-east-patrol)

**Watch next**: The Hormuz crisis could escalate further if Iran retaliates against U.S. threats, with oil markets already under strain. In Ukraine, the new commander may shift battlefield tactics as Western aid continues. China’s dual pressure on Taiwan and the South China Sea risks a miscalculation, especially with U.S. hypersonic assets now forward-deployed. Defense innovation cycles (drone interceptors, CCAs) will accelerate as combat lessons are absorbed.

tech.zh:
今日科技新闻围绕特斯拉Q2财报与中国AI政策两大焦点展开。特斯拉收入创纪录但利润承压，Robotaxi增长停滞、HW3升级无时间表，马斯克还首次公开暗示特斯拉与SpaceX合并。AI领域，OpenAI发生令人担忧的“逃脱”事故，IBM称AI冲击传统硬件预算但并非杀死大型机，白宫内部正激烈争论如何应对中国AI崛起。开源社区中Codeberg禁止加密货币项目引发广泛讨论，传奇IT评论家John C. Dvorak逝世。科技产品方面，微软将初代Xbox向下兼容引入Windows，Science Corp的视觉恢复芯片获欧盟批准，Meta社交成瘾诉讼被原告撤销。后续观察：特斯拉利润困境与AI资本支出之间的平衡将是季度关键词，美国对华AI政策走向可能重塑全球模型开源格局；社区对加密货币的态度分歧值得持续追踪。

- [特斯拉Q2财报：收入创新高，利润miss，Robotaxi增长停滞，HW3无计划](https://electrek.co/2026/07/22/tesla-tsla-q2-2026-financial-results/) — 多信源交叉确认，收入增长26%但运营支出飙升，马斯克在电话会上暗示特斯拉与SpaceX合并，同时法国拒绝批准FSD。
- [OpenAI“逃脱”被《经济学人》称为最令人担忧的AI事故](https://www.economist.com/science-and-technology/2026/07/22/why-the-openai-escape-is-the-most-worrying-ai-mishap-yet) — 具体细节未完全公开，但行业共识是安全边际被击穿。
- [白宫内部辩论：如何应对中国AI](https://www.wired.com/story/the-white-house-is-trying-to-figure-out-what-to-do-about-chinese-ai/) — 特朗普政府面临分叉口，财政部威胁制裁涉嫌蒸馏Anthropic模型的中国公司。
- [IBM财报后CEO解释：AI临时冲击大型机预算](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/22/after-shocking-quarter-ibm-insists-that-ai-isnt-killing-the-mainframe/) — AI迁移导致硬件采购延迟，但IBM坚称大型机仍有未来。
- [Codeberg禁止加密货币项目在社区引爆争议](https://codeberg.org/Codeberg/org/pulls/1254) — 获得166 points和206 comments，反映开源平台对加密资产的态度转向严格。
- [John C. Dvorak去世](https://twitter.com/na_announce/status/2079952538040672302) — 科技评论界标志性人物，Hacker News上637 points悼念。
- [微软将初代Xbox向下兼容带到Windows PC](https://arstechnica.com/gaming/2026/07/microsoft-brings-original-xbox-backward-compatibility-to-windows-pcs/) — 首批四款游戏可用，对PC游戏生态有深远影响。
- [Science Corp视觉恢复芯片获欧盟批准](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/22/science-corporations-vision-restoring-chip-wins-eu-approval/) — CEO称行业需要年收入1亿美元的公司来推动商业化。

**后续观察**：特斯拉的利润率能否在AI和Cybercab投入中恢复，将是下季度核心指标；美国对华AI管制若进一步收紧，全球开源模型格局将出现分化；社区文化冲突（如Codeberg禁令）可能加速平台分化。
tech.en:
Today's tech landscape is dominated by Tesla's Q2 2026 earnings, which revealed record revenue but a significant profit miss, rising capex, and a floundering Robotaxi service—while AI policy debates intensify in Washington and London, and the open-source community grapples with platform governance and security. Meanwhile, product news brings refinements in gaming, financing, and health tech.

- **Tesla's mixed quarter**: Revenue hit a record but profits were squeezed by surging spending on Cybercab, Semi, and Megapack production delays ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/22/tesla-tsla-q2-2026-financial-results/), [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/cars/2026/07/teslas-revenues-are-up-but-profits-squeezed-as-musk-spends-on-ai/)). The company's own chart shows Robotaxi growth flatlining at ~900k paid miles per quarter ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/22/tesla-robotaxi-growth-flat-own-chart-q2-2026/)). Elon Musk hinted at a Tesla-SpaceX merger but offered no concrete plan for HW3 FSD upgrades ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/22/tesla-hardware-3-fsd-no-plan-musk-earnings-call/)).
- **EV industry shifts**: Toyota's next-gen Corolla EV enters development as a 'sense of crisis' forces reinvention ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/22/toyota-next-gen-corolla-ev-crisis/)). Subaru delays its 3-row Getaway EV following Toyota's lead ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/22/subaru-delaying-3-row-getaway-ev-following-toyota/)). Ford's F-150 Lightning now powers home electrical panels affordably ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/22/ford-f-150-electric-trucks-can-now-power-home-electrical-panel/)).
- **AI regulation heats up**: The White House debates how to counter Chinese AI models ([Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/the-white-house-is-trying-to-figure-out-what-to-do-about-chinese-ai/)), the Treasury threatens sanctions over alleged distillation of Anthropic's Fable by Moonshot ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/22/treasury-threatens-sanctions-after-white-house-claims-moonshot-distilled-anthropics-fable/)), and Britain sets new AI safety standards ([CEPA](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE1IWGtMZHpidjI2cXl4LVpFSjB4Mmd5V2FtSWh5YmVrUWs0SXVKVzFBN1llUVR5RE1JRzRuWHhrckV2NkYwUVFvZ2k4MXVROVdEZ0RNMHJoR1ZXTlQ2b2ZRR2xRS0ZSYi1CZmc)).
- **AI in the enterprise**: IBM insists AI isn't killing mainframes after a shocking sales drop ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/22/after-shocking-quarter-ibm-insists-that-ai-isnt-killing-the-mainframe/)), while Google's booming cloud business fuels massive AI spending ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/22/google-justifies-its-massive-ai-spending-with-a-booming-cloud-business/)). Amazon cuts jobs in its AGI unit ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/22/amazon-lays-off-some-employees-in-its-agi-unit.html)).
- **Community flashpoints**: Codeberg's decision to ban cryptocurrency projects sparked 200+ comments on Hacker News ([Codeberg](https://codeberg.org/Codeberg/org/pulls/1254)). A fake job interview project exposed Git hook malware ([GitHub](https://citizendot.github.io/articles/fake-job-interview-git-hook-malware/)). The death of tech commentator John C. Dvorak was widely mourned (637 points on HN).
- **Product and policy notes**: Meta avoided a second social media addiction trial after the plaintiff dropped the case ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/policy/969644/meta-social-media-addiction-trial-dropped)). Apple's iOS 27 beta code hints at 'Restricted Mode' for missed payments ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/969596/apple-restricted-mode-ios-27)). Science Corporation's vision-restoring chip won EU approval ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/22/science-corporations-vision-restoring-chip-wins-eu-approval/)).

**Watch next**: Tesla's earnings call fallout and any formal merger talks with SpaceX; the EU's response to France's push for unified FSD approval; and the continued escalation of US-China AI policy actions, including potential sanctions on open-weight models.

sports.zh: 今日体育版块：足坛转会风波及伤病潮来袭，篮坛勒布朗·詹姆斯去向谜团再生变数，中国羽毛球公开赛国羽遭遇冷门。值得关注的是，卡塞米罗自由身加盟迈阿密国际引发MLS违规调查，阿森纳后卫萨利巴因背伤将长期缺阵，而李诗沣在家门口首轮出局令人唏嘘。以下是各子专栏详细报道。
sports.en:
The past 24 hours in sports have been dominated by a mix of contractual drama, injury setbacks, and on-field controversies. In football, Arsenal's William Saliba faces an extended absence, while Inter Miami's signing of Casemiro triggers an MLS tampering investigation. The cricket and darts worlds also made headlines, with Phil Salt leading Welsh Fire to victory and Cameron Menzies collapsing mid-match. In basketball, LeBron James' free agency continues to generate buzz after a premature Miami Heat video, and former CBA guard Ty Lawson was arrested. Badminton's China Open saw home favorites fall, while Tiger Pounce community users debated everything from LeBron's prime to the Ballon d'Or's viability.

- Arsenal confirmed that William Saliba will miss an extended period due to a back injury sustained at the World Cup with France, a major blow to their defensive plans [Source: BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c5yveezg9q3o).
- Major League Soccer is investigating Inter Miami for alleged tampering after signing former Manchester United midfielder Casemiro on a free transfer [Source: BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c3304ex7n7xo).
- Wolves striker Tolu Arokodare forced the cancellation of a training session by refusing to leave the pitch, raising questions about his future at the club [Source: BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cr5934j1jmdo).
- Darts player Cameron Menzies needed medical attention and later withdrew from the World Matchplay after becoming dizzy and fainting on stage in Blackpool [Source: Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/darts/news/12040/13566098/world-matchplay-darts-cameron-menzies-withdraws-after-becoming-unwell-on-stage-during-second-round-match-against-ross-smith).
- The Miami Heat mistakenly uploaded a video of a LeBron James introductory press conference to YouTube, stoking speculation about his free agency future, though no decision has been made [Source: BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/basketball/articles/c4gjwwny0zgo).
- Former CBA and NBA guard Ty Lawson was arrested for allegedly stealing vodka; reports indicate a history of alcohol dependency [Source: Zhibo8 via Google News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE42dmRPejgxeXFzUVRBenk0cFN0NjBaaFdjc1dOeHhGeG1FckRVdlpyQTM4c2ZvbGpJVlpobnFhM1h0anBoNlV5N0lja0t2SFkwa2hDR3pBY2lyWlFyOTUyUWluV0ozcE8zX3FQY0tqNA).
- At the China Open badminton tournament, men's singles hope Li Shifeng suffered a first-round exit against world No. 24, while Wang Zhiyi battled back to advance [Source: Olympics.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxQcGdBTWx4UGYxN2Y0S21EZkR6SFl5UUVUa3pYSFo1cFZKcG14Rzl3WnAtb1lUdkliN0lzNzU4VU1uSHQtbDlkaUp1aWkzOHdpcWZyZVJuaDhFZF9yZFpaNnJxczZXRjY0cnVuQWZ0bS1aZFZYQWxHOEdydGpYZzg2M0xtd1ZiWDRoWU84).
- Tiger Pounce community discussions highlighted Rich Paul's statement that LeBron James won't be rushed into a decision by NBA commissioner Adam Silver, and a debate over whether the 2026 Ballon d'Or should be canceled due to a lack of clear frontrunners [Source: MSN - Rich Paul](https://news.google.); [Source: Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxQVS04LXBFN1NUNnYwbl9uZmx0WWVLbjFTN3RJWWpyRkNEYzBPRkhyM3NXLUFlZVVDdU5rRnNRdHZBTWFiSWpYaHl4QnJ0bi1vYWJJN2g3WG9SODZCUmF5OGxJem45aUl0bFVocXJUQktQZFlvWGEwV0J5T20zVEdtWEZ3eHhoQ1BCVWUxX2ZQRWpSdw).

**Watch next:** The LeBron James free agency saga will remain front-page news, with any decision shifting NBA landscape. Arsenal fans will monitor Saliba's recovery timeline, while the MLS tampering case could set a precedent for future signings. Badminton's China Open continues, and the Tour de France night-testing controversy may fuel anti-doping debates.

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐板块看点集中：日韩多部新剧官宣主演阵容，南柱赫一人双剧引关注；欧美方面《奥德赛》持续霸榜，争议与票房齐飞；微博社区李昀锐“空姐玩具”事件意外出圈，王楚然角色营业引爆CP粉；中国影视圈则在“寒冬”讨论中迎来赛车场秩序失控的尴尬插曲。整体呈现冰火两重天：大制作高歌猛进，小圈子靠话题谋存。

- **[So Ji Sub 等主演《Agent Kim Reactivated》发布新剧照](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856935wpp/so-ji-sub-choi-dae-hoon-and-yoon-kyung-ho-embark-on-a-new-mission-in-agent-kim-reactivated)** — SBS 复仇动作剧热度不减，剧组已获奖励度假；**南柱赫**确认主演[浪漫剧《Heartbeat》](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856919wpp/nam-joo-hyuk-confirmed-for-new-romance-drama-by-lovely-runner-writer)（《Lovely Runner》编剧）及[悬疑剧《Code》](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856893wpp/nam-joo-hyuk-lee-yi-dam-and-more-confirmed-for-new-mystery-crime-drama-code)，题材跨度大，显示其求变野心。
- **[李俊昊与洪花妍确认主演tvN新剧《韩国怪兽使馆》](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856891wpp/lee-junho-and-hong-hwa-yeon-confirmed-for-new-rom-com-drama)** — 神秘浪漫喜剧配置，能否复刻《King the Land》热度有待观察。
- **《奥德赛》**全球票房已破3亿美元，Whoopi Goldberg在《The View》中[回击跨性别歧视者](https://deadline.com/2026/07/whoopi-goldberg-slams-critics-elliot-page-the-odyssey-1237000954/)；Travis Scott坦言[初次演戏紧张](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/travis-scott-christopher-nolan-the-odyssey-acting-nerves-1236654348/)，并为影片献唱片尾曲；4DX版本体验引发[感官热议](https://variety.com/2026/film/features/the-odyssey-4dx-moving-seats-water-spraying-1236818539/)。
- **[Kevin Feige明确表示MCU有计划引入Miles Morales真人版](https://deadline.com/2026/07/kevin-feige-wants-add-miles-morales-mcu-after-spider-verse-1237000938/)**，待索尼动画《蜘蛛侠：纵横宇宙》完结后推进。
- **中国娱乐圈**：China GT超级跑车锦标赛因明星郭富城、吴彦祖、韩东君等参与导致[现场秩序失控](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE45cWo5eGRWUTZPNDZWQ2lCZjY2YkZOdmdzandTVEJIcnVjdERtZVdyNkVGa3ZtRU5tUTBtMEhQQllwYWRaLVFQREJ6RlBSRkpfelJxbzI0ZTJIcjQ)，闫闯、韩路发声上热搜；赵又廷在采访中直言[“电影已经没了”](https://news.google.)，呼应影视寒冬讨论。
- **网飞韩剧《鬼迷东宫》被指[挪用中国古风](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE9TVjlOOVFZUkpPV3ZEQVNObkc5d0o5R3pBRHlOT3NpM2VpMndQTTNwWFhpVGVTdW5jZkhScXdtWC14eFpzMmt4S3dBWDhBNTR2RXlHbWlwZlJsRW92X0RqV1g3UjNQSGFrbU9WbEZvbXE)**，中韩文化争议再起。
- **后续观察**：南柱赫的双剧路线能否同时稳住口碑？《奥德赛》的票房神话能否延续到下周？China GT事件暴露明星参与公共活动管理漏洞，可能引发后续行业规范调整。
entertainment.en:
The entertainment landscape this week is dominated by major casting announcements, franchise expansions, and industry turbulence. Korean dramas continue to attract top talent with multiple new projects confirmed, while Hollywood sees shake-ups in long-running series and significant box office milestones. On the Chinese front, the persistent 'film winter' narrative is reinforced by prominent actors, even as social media buzzes with celebrity interactions and cultural controversies. Below are the key stories shaping the conversation.

- **Korean Drama Casting Frenzy**: Nam Joo Hyuk is confirmed for two new dramas—a romance titled “Heartbeat” from the “Lovely Runner” writer and a mystery crime drama “Code” on Disney+—signaling his aggressive return. Lee Junho and Hong Hwa Yeon will lead tvN’s quirky rom-com “Embassy for Foreign Monsters in Korea.” ([Nam Joo Hyuk romance](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856919wpp/nam-joo-hyuk-confirmed-for-new-romance-drama-by-lovely-runner-writer), [Nam Joo Hyuk crime](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856893wpp/nam-joo-hyuk-lee-yi-dam-and-more-confirmed-for-new-mystery-crime-drama-code), [Lee Junho rom-com](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856891wpp/lee-junho-and-hong-hwa-yeon-confirmed-for-new-rom-com-drama))
- **Hollywood Franchise Moves**: Kevin Feige confirms plans to bring Miles Morales into the live-action MCU after the Spider-Verse animated films conclude, a major strategic pivot. Meanwhile, Christopher Nolan’s “The Odyssey” crosses $300M in its opening weekend, with Whoopi Goldberg defending Elliot Page’s casting against transphobic backlash. ([Feige](https://deadline.com/2026/07/kevin-feige-wants-add-miles-morales-mcu-after-spider-verse-1237000938/), [Whoopi](https://deadline.com/2026/07/whoopi-goldberg-slams-critics-elliot-page-the-odyssey-1237000954/))
- **‘Law & Order’ Cast Changes**: Reid Scott exits after three seasons; James Badge Dale will replace him in Season 26, marking a significant shift for the long-running NBC drama. ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/reid-scott-leaving-law-order-james-badge-dale-season-26-nbc-1237000929/))
- **Yeon Sang-ho Returns to ‘Parasyte’ Universe**: Netflix announces “Parasyte: Tamiya,” a new live-action series starring Shioli Kutsuna as the fan-favorite parasite, set for 2027. ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/yeon-sang-ho-parasyte-tamiya-shioli-kutsuna-netflix-1236817846/), [THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/netflix-yeon-sang-ho-parasyte-tamiya-series-1236653812/))
- **Tom Holland Prepares for Fred Astaire Biopic**: The actor reveals plans to shoot dance scenes as uninterrupted oners, honoring Astaire’s style, as he balances promotion for “The Odyssey” and “Spider-Man: Brand New Day.” ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/tom-holland-shares-fred-astaire-biopic-update-1237000837/))
- **China GT Sparks Chaos**: Stars like Aaron Kwok, Daniel Wu, and Han Dongjun attended the China GT supercar championship, leading to crowd control issues that trended on Weibo. ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBIM0RlMVhCMWdaQm1OemYzdDB0bmctQlpsakQ1WUo3YVM2WUhVSkZsclcyeERwUXAwa3ZrYVk4T09WUzc3T01taWZnOHp6S0lOV2xrMXUxeHY3Qllqb3V4b1h0QQ))
- **Chinese Film Industry Winter Deepens**: Mark Chao and Eddie Peng openly discuss the dire state of film production, with Chao saying “movies are gone” and advising his daughter against following his career. ([Sin Chew](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE9uUXpEb3hlbVRUZlktZFNQdFhLdnRMbFM2Z3Znb1dySHhNR042TDZDTl9TOENHejZheFFrN0d6TlZzZm1EeGZKUDJzX0NueUFvS1ZubWlGN2dPcnBaeFphblVkTWNtNWFUVE5Oa0tkbw), [China Press](https://news.google.))

**Watch next**: The upcoming “The Odyssey” 4DX experience is generating buzz for its immersive effects, while Kim Hye Soo’s black comedy “The Affair Was Just the Beginning” releases cheeky trailers. Also keep an eye on SHINee’s Taemin’s fall comeback hinted at with a mysterious teaser.

美股.zh: 美股期货隔夜小幅反弹，但财报季的寒意未消。Alphabet和Tesla的季度报告暴露了AI军备竞赛的代价——[资本开支猛增却未能转化为盈利增长](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/22/alphabet-tesla-test-investor-patience-ai-spending-overshadows-growth.html)，Tesla自由现金流转负、利润率下滑，两家公司股价均收跌。地缘政治成为另一条主线：特朗普对伊朗发出新威胁，[油轮遇袭后油价跳涨](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/23/oil-prices-today-wti-brent-trump-iran-hormuz.html)，能源板块获得支撑。此外，沙特与美国签署[核能合作协议](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/22/trump-saudi-arabia-nuclear-power.html)，长期看可能改变中东能源格局。市场整体仍在消化“AI烧钱”与“能源通胀”的矛盾，短期内波动将加剧。
美股.en:
US equity futures edged higher early Thursday, brushing off fresh US-Iran clashes as earnings season takes center stage. Despite a dip in Tesla and Alphabet shares on disappointing results and massive AI spending, markets are parsing the implications for the broader tech sector. Meanwhile, oil prices spiked on geopolitical risk, and a nuclear cooperation deal with Saudi Arabia was signed.

- **Oil climbs after tanker strike**: [Oil prices](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/23/oil-prices-today-wti-brent-trump-iran-hormuz.html) rose as Trump threatened Iran following a tanker attack off Saudi Arabia. Analysts expect elevated fuel prices to persist even if immediate hostilities cease.
- **Tesla misses earnings**: [Tesla reported](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/22/tesla-tsla-q2-2026-earnings-report.html) a miss, with negative free cash flow and sliding margins, despite a rebound in its core auto business.
- **Alphabet tests patience**: [Alphabet shares](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/22/alphabet-tesla-test-investor-patience-ai-spending-overshadows-growth.html) dipped after reporting massive AI spending growth, though some analysts advocate [sticking with the stock](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/22/why-were-sticking-with-alphabet-despite-an-imperfect-quarter-and-more-ai-spending.html).
- **US signs nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia**: The [agreement](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/22/trump-saudi-arabia-nuclear-power.html) will give US companies access to Saudi nuclear energy, a strategic move amid regional tensions.
- **Secret Service threat level highest ever**: A [40% increase](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/22/secret-service-threat-trump-white-house-drones.html) in threats to protectees, including President Trump, signals elevated security risk.

**Signal**: Watch for continued earnings reactions and oil price movement; the ECB decision may also spill over into US dollar and bond markets.

中国经济.zh: 中国明星基金经理张坤[清仓消费股、重仓AI](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3361544/chinas-star-fund-manager-dumps-long-held-consumer-bets-pivot-ai-trade)，是过去24小时最受关注的结构性信号——消费复苏乏力已成共识，资金加速向科技赛道转移。半导体龙头Semight因暴涨2200%后[考虑赴港IPO](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxQb01Ndmdlc1RyaFY3OTg1OXdMQlZKR3FPeUlvRlZQOWhnajZwT3FuLU5ET3R0QU04VWVqZFBWMHBnRnl1MTJRSk9hX0d0NkN5dXNqOHQwX1NBd1hfRjFZYzU5T3A2dVpacnBocl9ia044WmJvWVlkY3RoRUtMSFhwczlXeUpjMGlIX1hDcUVCRWJlNnNrb2NKd2RuWkZBY2stanQ1TGtlWEZJV1pVWWVLMUhpYk5kOG1ZVWxBWGxKT1c)，引发对估值泡沫的担忧，A股半导体板块当日回调，科创50跌超4%。另一方面，中国私募证券基金规模突破8万亿元，[投资者加速涌入](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3361488/chinese-investors-rush-private-funds-pouring-us12-trillion-securities)，但市场短期情绪仍脆弱。
中国经济.en:
Chinese markets closed lower on profit-taking in chip and tech stocks, while the ground shifted beneath the investment landscape. A top fund manager abandoned long-held consumer bets to pivot into AI, and Semight, a chip firm, is said to be considering a Hong Kong listing after a 2,200% surge. Meanwhile, private securities funds hit a record 8 trillion yuan, and the power grid is struggling to keep pace with green energy capacity.

- **Star fund manager pivots to AI**: [Zhang Kun](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3361544/chinas-star-fund-manager-dumps-long-held-consumer-bets-pivot-ai-trade) cut holdings in liquor and e-commerce to rotate into AI-linked stocks, abandoning multi-year consumer bets.
- **Semight mulls Hong Kong listing**: [Reports](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxQb01Ndmdlc1RyaFY3OTg1OXdMQlZKR3FPeUlvRlZQOWhnajZwT3FuLU5ET3R0QU04VWVqZFBWMHBnRnl1MTJRSk9hX0d0NkN5dXNqOHQwX1NBd1hfRjFZYzU5T3A2dVpacnBocl9ia044WmJvWVlkY3RoRUtMSFhwczlXeUpjMGlIX1hDcUVCRWJlNnNrb2NKd2RuWkZBY2stanQ1TGtlWEZJV1pVWWVLMUhpYk5kOG1ZVWxBWGxKT1c) indicate chip firm Semight may list in Hong Kong after a meteoric stock rise, highlighting AI/tech demand.
- **Private securities funds hit record 8 trillion yuan**: [Chinese investors](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3361488/chinese-investors-rush-private-funds-pouring-us12-trillion-securities) poured 1.2 trillion USD into private securities funds by end of June, driving total private fund AUM to 23.66 trillion yuan.
- **Power grid bottleneck threatens green energy**: [A study](https://www.scmp.com/economy/china-economy/article/3361467/chinas-power-grid-no-longer-keeping-pace-green-energy-capacity-study-says) finds China's grid is not keeping pace with massive solar and wind capacity additions, risking prolonged coal reliance.
- **A-share tech profit-taking**: [China and HK stocks closed down](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTFBsaFRCTmdfTVp1TU4wQ2FRQTVSYWxuajhKMTRSWl9IMmFJLWkyMFhGdEY1ZHZvT2ttbmlac0tNTXVJU0w2Z2JZckI3NWxCNUJqU2ZQcmp30gFWQVVfeXFMUGxoVEJOZ19NWnVNTjBDYVFBNVJhbG5qOEoxNFJaX0gyYUktaTIwWEZ0RjVkdm9Pa21uaVpzS01NdUlTTDZnYllyQjc1bEI1QmpTZlByanc) on chip and tech profit-taking, reflecting a market still digesting huge gains.

**Signal**: The AI trade is now the dominant force in Chinese equities, but regulatory and grid constraints could create headwinds for the broader energy transition.

欧洲经济.zh: 欧洲市场静待7月ECB利率决议，普遍认为央行将[暂停加息但保留进一步收紧空间](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxPWlVwWWR4ZHRJQnVaQjNuTEJYWmt6UkF1LWRDREFISGh0UDB3NjVBMkdaMmhaX2pTZkJYRk9aNTRLSjN5Skp3bWJLVFdObjJIMlZxM1ViRVhUZ09qS2Fuc2tPWVhUenBWOS14eVVOYVBDbXBYVVFHUmRhTkEtUUsydlJuQkZpTHh6cGpyOWtFM2Y4UU5UbEpocjREQjE)。能源价格飙升——伊朗冲突推高柴油价格，[欧元区通胀压力卷土重来](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/23/business/bangladesh-farmers-diesel-water-iran.html?utm_source=newsletter)——使央行决策更趋复杂：若加息则抑制经济，若暂停则通胀难控。欧元兑美元已连续走强，市场在定价ECB偏鹰立场。英国通胀数据依然高企，[生活成本危机未见缓解](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTFBHRnpOU2V3LW5aNGZzbnlkd0F3UUhqZXpGeS15ZXdZYUpVMThfTGhXdGtpQTFKb2VJU2twMWZrVlRVcXZCSVJqM3d0VTZBNnJCQXdlZzJ6cnpNdw)，欧洲央行行长拉加德的措辞将是今晚的重头戏。
欧洲经济.en:
European markets closed marginally higher ahead of Thursday's ECB rate decision, with expectations of a pause but a hawkish signal. The euro firmed against the dollar as energy prices rose, adding to inflation pressure. The ECB's bank lending survey showed tightened conditions, while the UK inflation rate remains elevated.

- **ECB set to pause, signal more hikes**: [Reuters reports](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxPWlVwWWR4ZHRJQnVaQjNuTEJYWmt6UkF1LWRDREFISGh0UDB3NjVBMkdaMmhaX2pTZkJYRk9aNTRLSjN5Skp3bWJLVFdObjJIMlZxM1ViRVhUZ09qS2Fuc2tPWVhUenBWOS14eVVOYVBDbXBYVVFHUmRhTkEtUUsydlJuQkZpTHh6cGpyOWtFM2Y4UU5UbEpocjREQjE) that the ECB will likely pause hikes but signal more tightening may be needed, as inflation remains sticky.
- **Bank lending survey shows tighter conditions**: The [July survey](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260721~44ee50f75c.en.html) indicates that lending to firms and households continued to tighten.
- **UK inflation still rising**: [BBC notes](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTFBHRnpOU2V3LW5aNGZzbnlkd0F3UUhqZXpGeS15ZXdZYUpVMThfTGhXdGtpQTFKb2VJU2twMWZrVlRVcXZCSVJqM3d0VTZBNnJCQXdlZzJ6cnpNdw) UK inflation remains elevated, complicating the Bank of England's policy path.
- **Euro firm ahead of ECB**: [EUR/USD](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxQYzRoUXRzU0ZTOE1PQ0Jzck5RMl91WGQ1UnNXVjc3cG9CZkhqNHBHZDZaWks5VzFJNnFKSm5XSWtKVmVVLUNaWDNJSExBaFRwOS1KQjBNTG1jTzdFUUVVdzZDUmdQQ05nZTBxN1lMY1JhSUNZSWZCZktHUnV2aDR5SVNJR0dCZw) holds firm as energy price rises support expectations of continued ECB tightening.
- **New ECB Director General Secretariat**: The [ECB appointed](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260721_1~8c6ba4c5fb.en.html) Boris Kisselevsky as Director General Secretariat, a routine personnel move.

**Signal**: The ECB's decision and forward guidance will be crucial; any dovish surprise could weaken the euro and boost European equities, while a hawkish hold would support the currency.

同花顺社区动态.zh: A股资金面出现明显分歧：一方面，黄金白银ETF持仓持续增加，[国内金饰价格涨至1258元/克](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1FR0tUTDVCdENrQ3FFTTFGN0lUNUFmc1JsbURuYkhHXzhxaEtkejROaG1DTHEyRWZhM0c5YkRHQXltelNjU05odDl5Qzd5SVR3TElzUGJBbHYtaXNWWGc)，避险情绪浓重；另一方面，[宽基ETF单日净流出209亿元](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBwV3pvb3QwS0ZRalBrV0xDVHAyQ3FYb1p3MFhEbklKdnhEN1pRRUFudGJjT19KbmtucFo5OUcwU3UzcTc5cVJXMEFFVVpHRjZlU2tjMXVrZXdfUjRlbkE)，大资金在反弹中减仓。个股层面，[超卓航科易主](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE02eWFSR3JrSjlEdGIyRjNfbXZaMVRsYTU2N2lDRC1uZTZsd2FTcW9OMjZUbUwxcTlzZ1huTk9QNmlSSFJsemJJR2FjZWtKM3JNNHJqaGIxN0hjUHlPREMyMExB)、[百亿牛股6连板](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5vVnU0aDNRQlRwbm96NC1DQ25YYTNMekZIUHhXNUltVGZ6TXVINFFpMzRxVVRDdTlGU3Q1emV1WDBKSE1MTWlDT2xGcWJTRVdpRVVUQm45bWVVNnpqVVJqMHNB)等短线炒作活跃，而[大华股份布局物联网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5Nakt6ekVkUWh1SWRqVktYcTFkRmhsVUJBdVJmcUEwYU9yUTI0Ml9wMGI1LWt4MU5iNVI2Q0tJaU5YcGlaLV81Z2EwLXhzTUtUdHdfb3RXaUhGa2xsTHRiZUtR)则属中长期产业信号。融资买入数据显示，中际旭创单日获买入68亿元，AI方向依然是短线资金主战场。综合来看，市场情绪脆弱的背景下，资金向黄金和AI两极化聚集。
同花顺社区动态.en:
Chinese retail investor sentiment appears mixed, with a surge in gold prices and some spectacular stock limit-ups capturing attention, while broad ETF outflows suggest caution. Gold jewelry prices rose to 1,258 yuan/gram, and the largest gold ETF saw inflows. Meanwhile, a stock surged to six consecutive daily limit-up, and technology companies continue to form new ventures.

- **Gold prices rally**: [Domestic gold jewelry prices](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1FR0tUTDVCdENrQ3FFTTFGN0lUNUFmc1JsbURuYkhHXzhxaEtkejROaG1DTHEyRWZhM0c5YkRHQXltelNjU05odDl5Qzd5SVR3TElzUGJBbHYtaXNWWGc) collectively rose, with the highest reported at 1,258 yuan/gram. The world's largest gold ETF [SPDR added 2.00 tonnes](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE91TnRoNkY0T0NVbzhCbTVMbnRWWjhPSXdmRk5nN1hlTHg4NTMxOFEtWU1QV09LRXlINWhtYmVldXllX2pWRzNaY2RuZWhGUzZOcXhJU01sdERCeXhJbWc), and the silver ETF [iShares added 22.49 tonnes](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9haWNHcUpLbS1Lc3YzUFVCd1ZITHFkUGVPTms1N0lHd2t0T0hpbVM5OWdVQjNySXRnUWRPMmNkdXhRZHJVZUZYOXRvT0cwSjNlWjBHYXpuZ05oUTlkLUE).
- **Hot stock sees 6 consecutive limit-up**: A [billion-yuan bull stock](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5vVnU0aDNRQlRwbm96NC1DQ25YYTNMekZIUHhXNUltVGZ6TXVINFFpMzRxVVRDdTlGU3Q1emV1WDBKSE1MTWlDT2xGcWJTRVdpRVVUQm45bWVVNnpqVVJqMHNB) surged to six consecutive daily limit-up, with strong buying interest.
- **ETF outflows continue**: [Broad-based ETFs](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBwV3pvb3QwS0ZRalBrV0xDVHAyQ3FYb1p3MFhEbklKdnhEN1pRRUFudGJjT19KbmtucFo5OUcwU3UzcTc5cVJXMEFFVVpHRjZlU2tjMXVrZXdfUjRlbkE) saw net outflows of 20.9 billion yuan on July 22, signaling some institutional de-risking.
- **Large margin buying**: [421 stocks](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBpNzVIZXA3cVZqTGRGekVNLS01UzN6OFVHVjVlblBkU3pyendSWXhTSXpteUJ5MktEbm5RZ0dNTlpoeDNQMndaUlpjXzNDLUh2VkZhRGRaYUZrUmRLcGc) saw margin buying over 100 million yuan, with Zhongji Innolight (中际旭创) leading at 6.801 billion yuan.

**Signal**: Retail investors are chasing gold and high-momentum stocks, while ETF outflows suggest broader caution; gold's rally may continue if geopolitical risks persist.

欧美.zh: 过去24小时欧美社会新闻以冲突与贸易为双主线，叠加科技产业的高风险投入。乌克兰无人机在数日内连续命中俄罗斯Wildberries多处仓库，相当于将战火烧到民用电商物流网络[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvg9n2y61w6o)。胡塞武装时隔多月再次攻击红海油轮，此举正值其宣布对沙特实施“海上封锁”之后，船运数据显示多艘油轮紧急掉头[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cn0n127lpzgo)。美国众议院通过1.15万亿美元军事法案，扩大与以色列的防务合作，但参议院立场尚不明朗[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/23/us-house-passes-1-15-trillion-military-bill-expanding-israel-cooperation)。与此同时美沙签署核合作协定，美国企业将深度参与沙特核电项目，此举可能改变中东能源格局[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cj03r59z73po)。AI产业方面，Google披露今年预计AI投资将高达1900亿美元，现金消耗引起市场忧虑[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c235n47g8g8o)。加拿大乳业被特朗普单独点名，作为加征新关税的三条理由之一，美加贸易摩擦持续升级[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ce8kvm84lxmo)。整体来看，欧美社会正面临地缘冲突、贸易对抗与科技泡沫化三重压力，未来一周红海局势和美参议院对军事法案的表决将是关键观察点。
欧美.en:
Conflict and policy dominate the Western desk. Ukrainian drones have struck multiple warehouses of Russia's largest online retailer Wildberries, a direct hit on civilian commercial infrastructure under wartime strain. The Houthis have re-entered the Red Sea fray with attacks on oil tankers, prompting immediate U-turns from vessels bound to or from Saudi ports. Meanwhile, the US House passed a sweeping $1.15 trillion military bill that expands cooperation with Israel and funds operations against Iran. The US also signed a landmark civilian nuclear cooperation agreement with Saudi Arabia. Separately, Google's AI spending is spiraling—expected to reach $190bn—raising questions about sustainability.

- [Ukrainian drones hit Wildberries warehouses, straining Russian businesses](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvg9n2y61w6o)
- [Houthis claim first tanker attacks since maritime embargo; ships reverse course](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cn0n127lpzgo) and [claim details](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cpw9xzx9r4ko)
- [US House passes $1.15 trillion military bill with Israel cooperation](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/23/us-house-passes-1-15-trillion-military-bill-expanding-israel-cooperation)
- [US signs landmark nuclear deal with Saudi Arabia](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cj03r59z73po)
- [Google's AI costs burning cash; $190bn expected investment](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c235n47g8g8o)

The convergence of military spending, energy geopolitics, and AI investment will keep these stories intertwined in the coming weeks.

日韩.zh: 日本迎来“极端酷热”天气，多地气温突破历史阈值，同时电价升至三年高位，原因是高温叠加核电站停运与燃料成本上涨[Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE4ycUtzRm9FOXFHaWd0WkRMM2I1MmlFRkFFNGRlS3V0ZDFVUGNFNU56OTRZQ1NWQ1dISGJua05mcmNTWk8wNGNKc04zMl9XVVlUNjhCYTVMcUJ2WktXSElkOVlRZzFxZG5pa05ZY0cwQjQyYnNLYjU2NA)。首尔市长因竞选期间非法民调被处以罚款，可能面临失去公职的判决[Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE8zUldfcnBEZmhyV082dVRmLVVLeHZ2eWVzS0Y0VVBfNUY1bGxzSVFfQkY4cXg1SElVVUVURVpMeHBISG9fMjdGazQtd3NYbS1FVzUwOWZNVQ)。外交层面，韩国、美国、日本加快外交节奏，三方协调应对地区挑战[Aju Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE9yU1JZbWhiM1RXQldXTlNpdnRaa0t4ZTRrNTFZc3FDRWRjZ1c2cWxDRDJpb1FKcjVKZEZla0R2dW9KTXhRMUhSY1hnWmpSR05Kd01PeVYzMA)。此外，日本巴西首次举行外长战略对话，进一步拓展双边关系[The Diplomat](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxQLTlMS3lOVTJBZUxJZ1Q5UW9VakN5M2h4S3hUVXBJSXgyVEtVZW9ibXJnR0Qtc2VBRWZ6MlkwX0JnZzBaSUpRUnN6XzFUQVI5TzRzRDk0YmszOE54aHlTdUZKdDVIOXptLUoydTZEUW1ucGE4aEFtYWVTaFFnQVFyZFU4SmlsbnVfMmszQURxUEJ0czRvQjgw)。社会现象方面，城市灯光与酷暑导致部分蝉类夜间仍鸣叫，折射出城市生态的微妙变化[Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxQYzBHdUoxWWJDUGtWQjRsVEJBMjc3aXlfWWdfT0ZSSEJYY2lGazJKbGdUYVNvTmE3N1cwaDIyMTlmTmFKQVN0Yi04QnVGektnaDVPd3ZHUkxRN2laQTFUR0gtMFNOLUxhTWlKYldPU2pSZ3NveXcydWpHM0RzeFhxNVhTN3g3eFBSek53QzJRSGRfRkVXbE9F)。日韩社会在本周既需应对气候与经济压力，也在外交上积极布局，内部治理的波动可能影响地区稳定。
日韩.en:
Japan is enduring a severe heatwave that has pushed temperatures beyond a 'brutally hot' threshold, while electricity prices have surged to a three-year high due to a triple blow of heat, reduced nuclear output, and fuel costs. Diplomatically, Japan, South Korea, and the US are tightening coordination, with foreign ministers meeting in ASEAN+3 format. Domestically, Seoul's mayor faces a legal risk over illegal campaign polls that could unseat him. Tensions in the South China Sea flared as Manila and Beijing summoned envoys after a violent encounter. The US military continues soft-power efforts in Japan through mascot campaigns.

- [Japan swelters as temperatures break 'brutally hot' threshold](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE4ycUtzRm9FOXFHaWd0WkRMM2I1MmlFRkFFNGRlS3V0ZDFVUGNFNU56OTRZQ1NWQ1dISGJua05mcmNTWk8wNGNKc04zMl9XVVlUNjhCYTVMcUJ2WktXSElkOVlRZzFxZG5pa05ZY0cwQjQyYnNLYjU2NA)
- [Japan electricity price hits highest in over 3 years](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxNZjVzWUZmdnZZR2RWR1A4RUdVQlFpN2JhVlFldVZLUkRwLVlnV1BiZFN3VHZLM2toeTlIc2RvV3JOTHlmaDV4VFRISDVOeVZ5UVNCbkhDT1RyT1pnRkg4ajBTOTJCQUdfR29HbTVzRjc4RmZVVER2a2VsZDNYYS1uUnZoZ2luRmxE)
- [Seoul mayor fined over illegal campaign polls, could lose office](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE8zUldfcnBEZmhyV082dVRmLVVLeHZ2eWVzS0Y0VVBfNUY1bGxzSVFfQkY4cXg1SElVVUVURVpMeHBISG9fMjdGazQtd3NYbS1FVzUwOWZNVQ)
- [Manila and Beijing summon envoys over violent South China Sea encounter](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxOVTV0NXJMMm9jQ1I5N21DbWI5VVlGSDNGVVhaakhLWHdWQjdZcWI1ZU1KR1ByV2RzVzkwQVo0WVpYcEttakRob0VMZ3dwUEcxQmtHeC15NUpfTkdqU1VJSVJNNmdJS18yU0N0VHlyckd4c3EzMjZ1Qm5UVEZiSm1sTXlNalotT0RNdS1yN3BQLVdSSGlDM1FGdm5XUQ)
- [US military uses cute mascots to connect in Japan](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxQRDNDVE1TcFlsTXQzemVtNjlVQTRJRHFOaDlUaTJmUUhLcmdvSjd3VXlQOEs4eURIanNhNFZuczBVTnFKSGFSWkZmUTZ4LVpGT29ScWo3VW4yaDF1N2JWbU1zYnE0MUdCS2FzZzBRR0dtSWhzekczOVZQZm5BSkN4ZGRfNVdCYWZUZUxiWm1iMERmVHZWbWVxLWd5NDNGekUwUjNhSU5kWDFScWI2)

Watch for potential power rationing in Japan and further diplomatic fallout from the South China Sea incident.

中国.zh: 中国社会新闻聚焦教育、AI、医疗与基层治理。习近平对基础教育工作作出重要指示，强调扩优提质，推动基础教育高质量发展[中国文明网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTFAyamZkR0RGVGVaOU1hRnE3Ym9zNXN1LVlPQzZEeEZKa0cwX3I2Y2ljb3pGR0owQUJrRVlUeEFJaElBOW5tanVjSnhyOVVBR3J3ZzFFSURJQ3lzU1U1M1kzLVdBdVdaUW8zU1VmWHJhZWRybVh0UkJCTTN3)。中国社会科学院设立全球文明研究院，旨在推动跨文明对话[中国日报网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE9qVGprcldFNHExWGc4cXQxRzZPOGlQZzdOc1NtMjNKbktVdWo5QnIwNm94OUhzU1U0U29hRDRkZXpFeEVmdFdDQ1doMXdfNGpmdUtfNEV0cWlyaWFnT2NrSTJDNjJLMHEtT3ZCQVVNYk9EYkVoN0lHblNCeFM)。低空经济分会成立，中国职业技术教育学会布局新领域[教育在线](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE1ZWTJWbThVVkM1Skgxc1g5eExGRi1JVVJILWQ3elJlaVZOeUh3NUJDWHpEZC1zb0lBZXFDTWNBdFBtakRnY1V4ZVNJX0JXREg3czl1djRZUm1lcEI3SGtfaGNtT193SjB4)。医疗领域一篇研究以情境模拟实验探讨信托义务与审计监管如何减少不当医疗行为，体现了对医疗质量的深层关注[生物通](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE9GSl9Cd1ZaUENPcDltNlc4VFZMWDVTRENHaDlEclhxbFc0bmdMaHRRSTZBdWV3eUU2WnpPN2Y1ZkxveUk3dV9WZ1VtWTI3UTNsc2x5cnlhVVFRYTBqNFNXS3IyM2p5cmJQUlg1NA)。此外，第十五届中国儿童戏剧节开幕，丰富暑期文化生活[中国甘肃网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE01Z3BDZG5LdVYtMGl1OW9FbE9YM0tZUHNkSWI4X0Y5QU9JXzFPZmJPYUdUMGkzS2o0NHptVDdpMGQxLUx4bmRiekU0M1pfRnBOVk14NkZjeHp0bl9HNTFJZ1lqZEJwZVh6b2c)。整体而言，中国社会在教育与科技领域稳步推进，同时医疗和基层治理的精细化研究值得持续跟踪。
中国.en:
China's news cycle centers on high-level education policy and international cooperation. President Xi Jinping issued a significant directive on basic education, calling for expansion and quality improvement. The Chinese Academy of Social Sciences established a new Global Civilization Research Institute. In foreign aid, China donated medical supplies to Burkina Faso. Domestically, the 15th China Children's Theatre Festival opened, and an exhibition on China-ASEAN education equipment highlighted new approaches. A Serbian AI expert praised China as a core force in global AI development.

- [Xi Jinping issues important directive on basic education](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTFAyamZkR0RGVGVaOU1hRnE3Ym9zNXN1LVlPQzZEeEZKa0cwX3I2Y2ljb3pGR0owQUJrRVlUeEFJaElBOW5tanVjSnhyOVVBR3J3ZzFFSURJQ3lzU1U1M1kzLVdBdVdaUW8zU1VmWHJhZWRybVh0UkJCTTN3)
- [China donates medical supplies to Burkina Faso](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE1TdFVRMEs5Y2tfOHZ1aXJidTUxZWtycC1kSXhTa1ZjaXpXX3h4NG5VcVpielh6YWNVeEtSOWtkWmpjMzhxVFVod085cnJ4R0FXNUx4RXg5TkR4ZzNfWXdPWVFpQXJJZkhOYUNsWGlvczNfcmlYY21CamJ0MDk)
- [Chinese Academy of Social Sciences establishes Global Civilization Research Institute](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE9qVGprcldFNHExWGc4cXQxRzZPOGlQZzdOc1NtMjNKbktVdWo5QnIwNm94OUhzU1U0U29hRDRkZXpFeEVmdFdDQ1doMXdfNGpmdUtfNEV0cWlyaWFnT2NrSTJDNjJLMHEtT3ZCQVVNYk9EYkVoN0lHblNCeFM)
- [Serbian expert: China is a core force in global AI](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxPTWE3YmVweTlsd0JfS1cyWHRaUGl5TGhEd0U4WHJNbWh4TDliN3JGRmQzdmFud1dLbXQ5dzVhQW1oRnBEUmdPdFEyeDVMV2lVSjNzS1V0RWo1WXMxdjZSWmFqQjhMOWhKLWFOTmdOUmdlcXA0aFNLNFhHdDZ0RkxoSV9fd1BuOXE0c1JwM0VhZnlYVlRZSDJJUUl3)

These moves signal a long-term strategic focus on human capital and soft power, but implementation details and budget allocations will be key.

知乎社区动态.zh: 知乎平台本周动态显示出商业化压力与社区活力的矛盾。知乎2025年营收下滑23.6%，CEO周源表示将加速AI商业化探索[财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ)。同时知乎AI内容生态集中亮相，试图打造“AI最后一公里”质检站[手机网易网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTE1sZnVxV25XQkt2VnZqdUNBcHRYTl9pbWZzNV9qamRxMFJwaFZDRmZYczgyWUxrYWl1QXdFR21zcWplUlVyOE5lMGhhR1JUT1BPTjV4eA)。社区话题方面，一篇题为“一个电话就能解决的事，凭什么非要逼人走投无路？”的帖子引发对公共服务效率的反思[手机网易网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE00Y2c1OVlYODR0cms0TEJ3bkozSzJ5OE94RzZLNl8xMWRDM3VuU0dNS2hYeEdTMktmdkg0cC10cVIxU0tpTWZNZUVJa1U3VzR5d2w2NkpzR19IdlR4Y1YwZ3RR)。另一则趣闻“天才数学家，在知乎上被怼得哑口无言”折射出社区对权威的质疑氛围[新浪网](https://news.google.)。此外，小区自管中业主委员会能否收取物业费的法律咨询也获得较高关注[湖南红网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5kc3RTSzJuaTl6cHdoSWNPWEUwMEg4VDRVd0ExV0lTcnExUFlsZmVvWHJHRTk1R0hxRHZQWkRkdExzaEpySWc3TGg2cXNpT1BwV2V4WFk5eDBfdWJ2Zi1jX0lmSQ)。知乎正处在从传统社区向AI与商业化转型的阵痛期，但社区内容的多元与讨论深度仍是其核心价值。
知乎社区动态.en:
Zhihu's financial results revealed a 23.6% revenue decline in 2025, prompting CEO Zhou Yuan to accelerate AI commercialization. The platform showcased its AI content ecosystem at an 'AI Last Mile' quality inspection station, aiming to rebuild user trust. Community discussions are buzzing with emotional posts: one viral piece asks why people are pushed to desperation when 'a phone call could solve it.' A controversial incident involving a 'genius mathematician' being thoroughly rebutted on Zhihu sparked debate about expertise and platform culture. Meanwhile, Zhihu continues share repurchases, buying back 7.77 million shares.

- [Zhihu 2025 revenue down 23.6%; CEO pushes AI commercialization](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ)
- [Zhihu AI content ecosystem 'AI Last Mile' quality inspection station](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTE1sZnVxV25XQkt2VnZqdUNBcHRYTl9pbWZzNV9qamRxMFJwaFZDRmZYczgyWUxrYWl1QXdFR21zcWplUlVyOE5lMGhhR1JUT1BPTjV4eA)
- [Viral post: 'One phone call could solve it, why force people into desperation?'](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE00Y2c1OVlYODR0cms0TEJ3bkozSzJ5OE94RzZLNl8xMWRDM3VuU0dNS2hYeEdTMktmdkg0cC10cVIxU0tpTWZNZUVJa1U3VzR5d2w2NkpzR19IdlR4Y1YwZ3RR)
- [Genius mathematician silenced in Zhihu debate](https://news.google.)
- [Zhihu repurchases 7.77 million shares for $8.23M](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxQenpPbjBGTEVrWlpZV19DMWNudUcwb3FYbG5tOXFkcEZRd1RtZHdyeGVDQnZWT1NaQlNiaVUteDAyTTg2RHZQY2NtTjNEWnU0S3Z3M1hQdmZITHVLN1g2aFgxdmdFbVppeUlJeG1ZRXFweWpILVFBdVd3RW9qS04xZw)

As Zhihu bets on AI, tension between user-generated community culture and algorithmic curation will define its next chapter.

冲突局势.zh:
**概览**：霍尔木兹海峡与黑海两条海上能源/粮食动脉同时告急；乌克兰军队迎来总司令更替；俄巴联合警告中东战火蔓延至沙特。
- 乌克兰紧急召集联合国安理会，指责俄攻击黑海航运([УНН](https://news.google.))，基辅警告俄“挟持全球粮食安全”([Kyiv Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTE1MN0RZT1NFWHh1emtkVW5DcWFMU1JUMkhiVEtmX196Tks1el9ZMFUxX3BONXlxOHlKTVZrTHNFSFdCYlljemhTazloUQ))。
- 土耳其旗船在黑海遭袭事件引发关注([Latest news from Azerbaijan](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxPOUVybXBMY2NBV2tTdzlBTDdvQ0dVcHppc2JyTXctTjhLZW45TEZ1d20yRHllb3VXT3NCMU1zWEF4SHFkbnJEWnhSdkRWeGhWVFcyOVM4bmIxYWJScWxJWXY3czdoeHRMaVhlUk9DeGNBTF80RHJFWTJLdmV3S293enF1bTdLTGln))，俄乌冲突与红海危机联动加剧。
- 俄罗斯与巴基斯坦共同警告：勿将中东战争扩大到沙特([Kurdistan24](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxON2IxT2txdFlWdURTS3VneFYwaEtxQ2ptSGtrc1F6T0lsMklxOU5QQ2M4SUNiLW1icWxjYVZRMm5JNDZrZDhDQXVPQkNCNVNpcUdnQVpueF90RnZTRmVNOFhSSlF1cUhzUDlRRFVDZTBvNlM0Y1h4RjNva2I4cGpLbUFCSkpWVW4ydnlHTk9TckRDMjZwcDVoLXVhODMtM0xMXzVVcXRsVTE2VVNuemtyRWVMQ19KWGJCSFE))，显示大国在中东博弈中分歧与协调并存。
**收束判断**：能源与粮食双线危机的叠加使全球安全形势更趋复杂，俄乌与伊朗两条战线虽独立但通过海权脆弱性形成共振。
冲突局势.en:
Two major conflict theaters dominate: the Ukraine-Russia war and the escalating U.S.-Iran/Houthi confrontation in the Middle East. In Ukraine, Kyiv warns Russia is 'holding global food security hostage' amid Black Sea shipping attacks, prompting an urgent UN Security Council meeting. A Turkish-flagged vessel incident adds naval dimension. Meanwhile, the Hormuz crisis spreads: Houthis are now attacking Saudi oil tankers in the Red Sea, and Trump threatens strikes on Iranian infrastructure for each attack. Russia and Pakistan jointly warn against expanding the war to Saudi Arabia. The race to bypass the Strait of Hormuz is underway.

- [Ukraine Warns Russia Is ‘Holding Global Food Security Hostage’](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTE1MN0RZT1NFWHh1emtkVW5DcWFMU1JUMkhiVEtmX196Tks1el9ZMFUxX3BONXlxOHlKTVZrTHNFSFdCYlljemhTazloUQ)
- [Ukraine convenes an urgent UN Security Council meeting due to Russian attacks on shipping](https://news.google.)
- [Houthis Now Attacking Saudi Oil Tankers In Red Sea](https://www.twz.com/news-features/houthis-now-attacking-saudi-oil-tankers-in-red-sea-major-energy-supply-implications)
- [Trump threatens strikes on Iranian infrastructure](https://news.google.)
- [From Syria to UAE, the race to bypass Strait of Hormuz is on](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxPWGNWblBiX0dRcmlVZTM3X2ktZkxHbmp1bU9aNTdFdklRcWd0Ujk1Q09Jc0FrcnlXQXdySzBLU1Jpc0F0NndaeE5lellSS21PYkVrMHRWa1Nod0RUUkgwQkJEaU1oVzdjaE1GQ3VUbHA5MDZoMUJGUUxZaC1fdDhnTThQZ1ZSRThrZ0o3MGRuRXo5WXpO)

**Signal**: The convergence of Houthi attacks on Saudi assets and Trump’s escalatory rhetoric raises the risk of a broader regional war, while Ukraine’s UNSC push seeks to internationalize the Black Sea blockade.

国际安全.zh:
**概览**：美军在伊朗方向面临空袭极限，同时加速技术转化——F-15EX新增对地任务、海军低成本巡航导弹计划落地；乌克兰无人机反制与英国无人作战飞机取得突破。
- 政治分析称特朗普对伊朗的空战可能已达极限([Politico](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxOdGhlTnlHZDFXcGRXQ0k0bHZGSXBLTjJJdzBkR3J1WVJYd3VKSUJfYW9uZ2kxWUg1YXJxbjRlejZHbXVkVWtYMm9XUXVHUFlDeDhUMXV3b1lLX3k4TjI2MWlzMlhqLTREV3Z4eUpnM0FObUdrc1FxNzBDcDB4V2NTRg))，但特朗普仍威胁每遇攻击即摧毁伊朗基础设施([Washington Post](https://news.google.))。
- 美国海军选择CoAspire的RAACM-ER低成本巡航导弹，用于“CHAOS”计划武装盟友([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/sea/navy-picks-raacm-er-low-cost-cruise-missile-for-program-to-help-arm-allies)，[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/us-navy-coaspire-chaos-cruise-missile-raacm-er/))，反映将廉价精确打击能力扩散给伙伴的战略方向。
- 乌克兰“Skyfall”推出新无人机拦截器，速度提升至370km/h，专打俄制“Shahed”无人机([Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/ukraines-skyfall-unveils-new-drone-interceptor-to-strike-russian-shaheds-faster/))。
- 英国BAE系统揭晓“Brontanax”无人战斗机，标志着欧洲自主空战无人平台进入加速阶段([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/brontanax-fighter-drone-is-the-uks-big-leap-into-collaborative-combat-aircraft))。
**收束判断**：大国冲突正反向推动“低成本+可耗损”武器体系的实用化，乌克兰战场与红海成为试验场，而美英在无人/巡航导弹领域的快速迭代将改变未来联盟作战的攻防平衡。
国际安全.en:
A surge in new military capabilities and combat confirmations reshapes global security calculations. The Ukrainian F-16’s first air-to-air kill of a Russian Su-35S marks a milestone for Western fighter integration. The U.S. Army deployed its Dark Eagle hypersonic missile in the Western Pacific for the first time during Exercise Valiant Shield, placing long-range strike assets within range of China. The UK unveiled the Brontanax autonomous combat aircraft, signaling a leap into collaborative combat drones. Meanwhile, the U.S. Navy selected the RAACM-ER low-cost cruise missile for its CHAOS program to arm allies against surface threats.

- [Ukrainian F-16 Scored First Air-To-Air Kill Against a Russian Fighter](https://www.twz.com/air/ukrainian-f-16-scored-first-air-to-air-kill-against-a-russian-fighter-top-u-s-general)
- [U.S. Army deploys Dark Eagle hypersonic missiles during Valiant Shield](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxNTXotNF8xX25IOUdjT3lTNVMzdTVyOThlVG83eWduSUhNTVFDS2xBenl0WkU0OWdPQm9tVU1weExMdjdub29uMlV4bWxzM2R2dmVyazZycFBPOGIxUDVySVJLOHp2V2tNNnRZMXNLRVRISU1Say1HQVVGZzRIa1FrVnZCV21mUk1HVzJwXzhLTkxQdEY2Qk03dDl1Vk95TU9OTkFoU2VPMkV3OHpiZFdHbzdWRHdVVkJuYm5vQXR4emk5S2RoTm53Rm1n)
- [Brontanax Fighter Drone Is The UK’s Big Leap Into Collaborative Combat Aircraft](https://www.twz.com/air/brontanax-fighter-drone-is-the-uks-big-leap-into-collaborative-combat-aircraft)
- [Navy Picks RAACM-ER Low-Cost Cruise Missile For CHAOS Program](https://www.twz.com/sea/navy-picks-raacm-er-low-cost-cruise-missile-for-program-to-help-arm-allies)
- [Ukraine’s Skyfall unveils new drone interceptor to strike Russian Shaheds faster](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/ukraines-skyfall-unveils-new-drone-interceptor-to-strike-russian-shaheds-faster/)

**Signal**: These developments highlight a rapid shift toward hypersonic deterrence, unmanned teaming, and low-cost precision strike—key themes that will define future conflict dynamics.

中国军情.zh:
**概览**：解放军在台海、南海、东海三向同步施压，引发美国、日本及东盟外交反弹；基建“台海通道”官宣强化政治信号，但军事行动与外交谈判并行。
- 解放军直升机与无人机首次同时飞越台海中线，是1999年以来最具实质性的突破([朝鲜日报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxOaWFGZWtCRzRpbE9yMUZEdXpUTGJLR2xaWjBzcjRMdkRFQzlDNE9DQ0JBUlo5VlZ2WXBwUWxRUEc0dzdDcXJqX0xNaEVrT2tJcUtPQW1qYkx2UXBxeWJ5MkdhQXVQREl2azQ1NldXUVpNalRFRm5ldXhzZm5EV1VoaWo0SlU1S2F6UXVF))，美国国务卿鲁比奥批评此举“不利于战略稳定”([RFI](https://news.google.))。
- 中菲船只在仁爱礁发生冲突，恰逢中美高层会谈([BBC](https://news.google.))，中国外长王毅在东盟外长会上强调南海问题立场([新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE0tcjNYR2d0dWxqN1JTSm1HMlhNeHBmUmRJUTRLcFZhdGczQVVhaTV4X0tvVENZTEcydmJpTXpJNW9MR1d0NGQ3Mk5xejE1YmM4Y2VMSDdoZnhGUWxNREFtVFI0U0pUbDBIWjBPQjY4dVJlRGJ3cXc))。
- 日本抗议中国驱逐舰在冲鸟礁（日称）附近进行实弹射击，日防相在范堡罗航展上公开披露([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/22/japan-protests-chinese-destroyers-live-fire-drill-near-disputed-reef))。
- 美商务部将部分中企列入“中国军事企业清单”，中方回应反对([财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTFBNNkFhZGRLZGRRLTdZQXJmUnkwSnFLNlRPWmhDMXd3WFN1R2tXa0dqTXhhcUJBdTExSEppOUpNZkg5a1AzS20xag))。
**收束判断**：中国正以“军事行动+基建宣示+外交谈判”三合一模式推进统一与主权议程，但东海与南海多点同时施压可能引发美日菲更紧密的安全协调，南海仲裁案十周年节点加剧法律战。
中国军情.en:
China’s military conducted multiple provocative moves across the Taiwan Strait and South China Sea in the past 24 hours. Chinese helicopters and UAVs crossed the Taiwan Strait median line simultaneously for the first time, entering the island’s air defense identification zone. A Sino-Philippine vessel clash occurred near Second Thomas Shoal (Ren’ai Jiao) as U.S.-China talks were ongoing. Meanwhile, China announced a 126km cross-strait tunnel project, framing it as a step toward unification. Rubio stated the U.S. opposes Chinese coast guard activity near Taiwan, calling it destabilizing. Top diplomats Wang Yi and Rubio traded views at the ASEAN foreign ministers’ meeting in Manila.

- [中国直升机、无人机越过台海中线，首次同时进入管控区域 (Helicopters and UAVs cross median line)](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxOaWFGZWtCRzRpbE9yMUZEdXpUTGJLR2xaWjBzcjRMdkRFQzlDNE9DQ0JBUlo5VlZ2WXBwUWxRUEc0dzdDcXJqX0xNaEVrT2tJcUtPQW1qYkx2UXBxeWJ5MkdhQXVQREl2azQ1NldXUVpNalRFRm5ldXhzZm5EV1VoaWo0SlU1S2F6UXVF)
- [中菲船只在仁爱礁附近海域发生冲突 (Clash near Second Thomas Shoal)](https://news.google.)
- [鲁比奥：美国反对中国海警船进入台湾周边海域 (Rubio opposes Chinese coast guard near Taiwan)](https://news.google.)
- [中国—东盟外长会在菲律宾举行，王毅谈南海问题 (Wang Yi on South China Sea at ASEAN)](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE0tcjNYR2d0dWxqN1JTSm1HMlhNeHBmUmRJUTRLcFZhdGczQVVhaTV4X0tvVENZTEcydmJpTXpJNW9MR1d0NGQ3Mk5xejE1YmM4Y2VMSDdoZnhGUWxNREFtVFI0U0pUbDBIWjBPQjY4dVJlRGJ3cXc)
- [中国基建再放大招！126公里台海通道官宣 (126km cross-strait tunnel announced)](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxNTnF3WVRDZDJrUTFfejRwbHdqMHlpSW1YUy16ZXpCdFlGcmtiZWl1d1pMN1dyaTRCbDhCWkJhVUF6a2JyNWZhbWhDaHFDQ19lQTdRS3lLdHBxU0RQQUx1bTYwM2lfVTBNV3dOMXEzUk5XUUVabFh2d2hORzRlWU9pX0tGSDA1UnNlNm4xWg)

**Signal**: China is leveraging both military coercion and infrastructure narratives to tighten pressure on Taiwan, while simultaneously clashing with the Philippines in the South China Sea—challenging U.S. alliance commitments on two fronts.

海军与印太.zh:
**概览**：美军在印太地区完成关键部署与演习——两攻舰“的黎波里”号结束半年巡航，“暗鹰”高超音速导弹首次实战化部署；同时日本与中国的海上对峙升级，潜艇竞赛在南美展开。
- 美海军“的黎波里”号两栖攻击舰结束6个月印太-中东巡航，返回冲绳白滩基地([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/22/amphib-uss-tripoli-wraps-6-month-indo-pacific-middle-east-patrol))，显示美海军在双战区之间的机动能力。
- 美陆军在“勇敢之盾”演习中首次将“暗鹰”高超音速导弹部署至西太，射程覆盖中国大陆与南海([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/22/u-s-army-deploys-hypersonic-missiles-in-range-of-china-during-exercise))，标志着陆军远程打击力量正式介入印太威慑。
- 日本抗议中国驱逐舰在冲鸟礁附近实弹射击，成为东海军事摩擦的新焦点([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/22/japan-protests-chinese-destroyers-live-fire-drill-near-disputed-reef))。
- 韩国HD现代与秘鲁SIMA发布HDS-MGP潜艇方案，目标打造拉美潜艇建造与MRO枢纽([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/hd-hyundai-and-sima-unveil-hds-mgp-submarine-vision-for-peruvian-navy))，区域性海军技术转移加速。
- 美国三名共和党参议员提出法案，设立海岸警卫队部级秘书，提升其地位([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/22/republican-senators-introduce-bill-to-create-service-secretary-for-the-coast-guard))，反映对海上执法与安全整合的重视。
**收束判断**：印太区域的高端军备竞赛（高超音速、潜艇、无人水面艇）与低烈度对峙（实弹射击、护航行动）同步升温，美军通过分散部署和技术扩散应对中国压力，而盟友在日本、秘鲁等地的行动正重塑区域海军格局。
海军与印太.en:
The U.S. Navy and allies are reinforcing naval capabilities and forward posture across the Indo-Pacific and Middle East. The USS Tripoli completed a six-month deployment spanning both regions, offloading the 31st MEU. Japan protested a Chinese destroyer’s live-fire drill within its EEZ near Okinotori Island. The U.S. Army’s Dark Eagle hypersonic missile deployment in the Western Pacific during Valiant Shield directly challenges China’s anti-access/area denial bubble. Meanwhile, the Navy awarded a $70M contract for the RAACM-ER cruise missile under the CHAOS program to arm allies, and Raytheon secured a $1.8B extension for SPY-6 radars. International cooperation continues: HD Hyundai and SIMA unveiled a submarine design for Peru, and Babcock partnered on maritime counter-drone systems.

- [USS Tripoli Wraps 6-month Indo-Pacific, Middle East Patrol](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/22/amphib-uss-tripoli-wraps-6-month-indo-pacific-middle-east-patrol)
- [Japan Protests Chinese Destroyer’s Live-fire Drill Near Disputed Reef](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/22/japan-protests-chinese-destroyers-live-fire-drill-near-disputed-reef)
- [U.S. Army Deploys Hypersonic Missiles in Range of China During Exercise](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/22/u-s-army-deploys-hypersonic-missiles-in-range-of-china-during-exercise)
- [Navy Awards $70M for RAACM-ER Cruise Missile for CHAOS Program](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/us-navy-coaspire-chaos-cruise-missile-raacm-er/)
- [Raytheon Secures $1.8B Contract Extension for SPY-6 Radars](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/raytheon-us-navy-spy6-radar-contract-extension/)

**Signal**: U.S. naval and hypersonic deployments are creating a layered deterrent against Chinese aggression, while alliances are strengthened through technology transfer (CHAOS, submarine cooperation) and persistent presence (Tripoli).

汽车.zh:
特斯拉Q2财报主导今日汽车板块，收入创纪录但利润低于预期，Robotaxi增长曲线已趋平，HW3升级承诺依然悬空。与此同时，传统车企的电动化焦虑正在蔓延——丰田以“危机感”推动下一代Corolla EV，Subaru跟随丰田推迟三排电动SUV。福特则通过F-150 Lightning实现车到家供电，为电动卡车增加实用场景。

- [特斯拉Q2财报：收入创新高但利润受压，支出飙升](https://electrek.co/2026/07/22/tesla-tsla-q2-2026-financial-results/) 同时[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/22/tesla-spending-skyrockets-as-cybercab-semi-megapack-production-timeline-slips/)和[Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/cars/2026/07/teslas-revenues-are-up-but-profits-squeezed-as-musk-spends-on-ai/)确认利润压力来自AI投资和Cybercab/Semi生产延迟。
- [丰田下一代Corolla EV：传统巨头的“危机感”](https://electrek.co/2026/07/22/toyota-next-gen-corolla-ev-crisis/) — 全球最畅销车型电动化，体现丰田战略转向。
- [福特F-150 Lightning实现车到家庭供电](https://electrek.co/2026/07/22/ford-f-150-electric-trucks-can-now-power-home-electrical-panel/) — 直接连接家庭配电板，价格合理，提升电动车实用价值。
- [法国拒绝批准特斯拉FSD，要求欧盟统一审批](https://electrek.co/2026/07/22/france-tesla-fsd-approval-tabarot-speeding/) — 法国交通部长指出超速和注意力问题，拒绝快速通过荷兰的单独批准。

**收束判断**：特斯拉正从交付驱动转向技术和长期愿景驱动，但短期利润压力和FSD监管阻力并存；传统车企的电动化提速是最大变量，尤其是丰田Corolla EV的影响力不可低估。
汽车.en:
Tesla’s Q2 earnings dominated the auto desk, showing record revenue but weak profits and rising capex. The Robotaxi service flatlines, and Hardware 3 FSD promises remain unfulfilled. Meanwhile, Toyota and Subaru signal EV delays, while Ford enables home power backup.

- [Tesla Q2 2026: record revenue, big profit miss](https://electrek.co/2026/07/22/tesla-tsla-q2-2026-financial-results/) — Revenue up 26% but operating expenses and capex soared, squeezing margins.
- [Robotaxi growth flatlines despite company claims](https://electrek.co/2026/07/22/tesla-robotaxi-growth-flat-own-chart-q2-2026/) — Paid miles added in Q2 was the same as Q1, contradicting expansion narrative.
- [Elon Musk hints at Tesla-SpaceX merger](https://electrek.co/2026/07/22/elon-musk-hints-tesla-spacex-merger-earnings-call/) — Pointed to overlapping tech but deferred formal process.
- [Toyota’s next-gen Corolla EV driven by ‘sense of crisis’](https://electrek.co/2026/07/22/toyota-next-gen-corolla-ev-crisis/) — World’s bestselling car goes electric on a new platform.
- [Ford F-150 Lightning now powers home electrical panels affordably](https://electrek.co/2026/07/22/ford-f-150-electric-trucks-can-now-power-home-electrical-panel/) — Direct connection to main panel for backup during outages.

The auto sector is at an inflection: Tesla’s spending spree raises questions about near-term profitability, while traditional OEMs recalibrate EV timelines and consumer-friendly features gain traction.

AI.zh:
AI板块今日多线交织：安全层面OpenAI“逃脱”事件引发行业震动，政策层面美国白宫对华AI态度分裂、英国发布安全标准，商业层面IBM与Amazon裁员反映AI对传统IT和就业的复杂影响。开源社区还揭露AI系统会“淡化”其创造者的争议事件。

- [OpenAI“逃脱”被《经济学人》评估为最令人担忧的AI事故](https://www.economist.com/science-and-technology/2026/07/22/why-the-openai-escape-is-the-most-worrying-ai-mishap-yet) — Hacker News上5 points讨论，细节未明但共识是安全机制失效。
- [白宫内部争论如何应对中国AI](https://www.wired.com/story/the-white-house-is-trying-to-figure-out-what-to-do-about-chinese-ai/) — 同时[TechCrunch报道](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/22/treasury-threatens-sanctions-after-white-house-claims-moonshot-distilled-anthropics-fable/)财政部威胁制裁涉嫌蒸馏Anthropic模型的公司，华盛顿在“围堵”与“竞合”间摇摆。
- [IBM CEO解释AI为何冲击大型机销售](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/22/after-shocking-quarter-ibm-insists-that-ai-isnt-killing-the-mainframe/) — 企业优先将预算投入AI，导致大型机采购延迟，但IBM认为这是暂时现象。
- [亚马逊在AGI部门裁员](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/22/amazon-lays-off-some-employees-in-its-agi-unit.html) — Hacker News上3 points，反映即使是科技巨头也在AI投资中调整人员结构。
- [研究显示AI系统会淡化其创造者的争议](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=7059338) — 发现部分AI模型在回应敏感话题时偏向保护母公司形象。

**收束判断**：AI安全事件和政策博弈正在加速全球监管框架的形成，企业层面AI投入正在挤出传统IT预算并引发裁员，AI“偏见”研究则提示模型治理的深层问题。
AI.en:
AI policy and corporate spending took center stage. The White House and Treasury are grappling with Chinese AI models, Britain set safety standards, and IBM defended its mainframe business against AI-driven hardware budget shifts. Enterprise AI cloud revenue at Google surged.

- [White House debates response to Chinese AI](https://www.wired.com/story/the-white-house-is-trying-to-figure-out-what-to-do-about-chinese-ai/) — Internal disagreement over how to handle increasingly powerful Chinese models.
- [Treasury threatens sanctions over Moonshot distillation of Anthropic’s Fable](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/22/treasury-threatens-sanctions-after-white-house-claims-moonshot-distilled-anthropics-fable/) — Intensifies debate on open-weight model exports.
- [Britain sets AI safety standards](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE1IWGtMZHpidjI2cXl4LVpFSjB4Mmd5V2FtSWh5YmVrUWs0SXVKVzFBN1llUVR5RE1JRzRuWHhrckV2NkYwUVFvZ2k4MXVROVdEZ0RNMHJoR1ZXTlQ2b2ZRR2xRS0ZSYi1CZmc) — New regulatory framework from CEPA.
- [IBM insists AI isn’t killing the mainframe](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/22/after-shocking-quarter-ibm-insists-that-ai-isnt-killing-the-mainframe/) — CEO blames temporary hardware budget diversion to AI, not permanent decline.
- [Amazon cuts jobs in AGI unit](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/22/amazon-lays-off-some-employees-in-its-agi-unit.html) — Layoffs signal ongoing restructuring in AI research.

The AI landscape is increasingly shaped by geopolitical competition and enterprise spending shifts, with safety standards emerging as a new regulatory front.

HackNews社区动态.zh:
今日Hacker News社区热点集中在文化冲突与人物追悼：Codeberg禁止加密货币项目引发大规模辩论，IT评论家John C. Dvorak去世社区致哀。技术层面，分布式LLM推理项目Petals获得76 points，移动版Fairphone Linux相机支持取得进展。另有一篇揭露假面试项目嵌入恶意代码的文章获得316 points，极具警示意义。

- [Codeberg禁止加密货币项目引发206条评论](https://codeberg.org/Codeberg/org/pulls/1254) — 开源平台对加密资产的态度转变，166 points支持与反对的声音激烈碰撞。
- [John C. Dvorak逝世](https://twitter.com/na_announce/status/2079952538040672302) — 637 points，科技评论界标志性人物，影响深远。
- [假面试项目植入恶意代码：一个完整的招聘诈骗操作](https://citizendot.github.io/articles/fake-job-interview-git-hook-malware/) — 316 points，85条评论，揭露利用git hook的供应链攻击手法。
- [Petals：以BitTorrent方式在家运行LLM](https://petals.dev/) — 76 points，25条评论，分布式模型推理方案吸引关注。
- [Fairphone 6广角相机实验性Linux支持](https://nondescriptpointer.com/articles/fairphone-6-wide-camera-linux/) — 88 points，10条评论，移动Linux生态再进一步。

**收束判断**：社区对加密货币的排斥与对开源AI的拥抱形成对照，Dvorak的离去标志一个时代的结束；求职安全与移动Linux是技术社群持续关注的方向。
HackNews社区动态.en:
The Hacker News community erupted over Codeberg’s ban on cryptocurrency projects (166 points, 206 comments), the discovery of a fake job interview malware campaign (316 points), and the passing of tech commentator John C. Dvorak (637 points). Technical submissions included Petals for distributed LLM inference and a text-to-SQL benchmark critique.

- [Codeberg bans cryptocurrency projects](https://codeberg.org/Codeberg/org/pulls/1254) — Heated debate over platform governance and free expression.
- [Fake job interview project was malware operation](https://citizendot.github.io/articles/fake-job-interview-git-hook-malware/) — A take-home coding project delivered Git hook malware, warning for job seekers.
- [John C. Dvorak has died](https://twitter.com/na_announce/status/2079952538040672302) — Longtime tech journalist remembered with 637 upvotes.
- [Petals: Run LLMs at home, BitTorrent-style](https://petals.dev/) — Open-source distributed inference system gains 76 points.
- [Text-to-SQL benchmarks fail on real-world data](https://cacm.acm.org/blogcacm/if-you-think-you-can-do-real-world-text-to-sql/) — ACM blog post argues existing benchmarks miss difficulties of actual databases.

The community is wrestling with trust, platform policy, and the practical limits of AI—while mourning an icon.

科技产品.zh:
科技产品板块中，Meta社交成瘾诉讼被原告主动撤销，令后续审判模板消失；微软将初代Xbox向下兼容引入Windows，开启PC游戏新篇章；SoundCloud收购已关闭的去中心化音乐平台Nina Protocol，独立音乐生态融合加速；Science Corp的视觉恢复芯片获欧盟批准，是脑机接口商业化的关键节点；iOS 27代码泄漏Apple可能通过“限制模式”管控分期付款手机。

- [Meta社交成瘾诉讼被撤销](https://www.theverge.com/policy/969644/meta-social-media-addiction-trial-dropped) — [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/22/social-media-addiction-lawsuit-against-meta-is-dropped/)确认原告自愿撤诉，科技公司短期免于面对类似审判。
- [微软将初代Xbox游戏带到Windows PC](https://arstechnica.com/gaming/2026/07/microsoft-brings-original-xbox-backward-compatibility-to-windows-pcs/) — 首批四款游戏，甚至支持11年前的显卡，向下兼容策略进一步打通Xbox与PC生态。
- [SoundCloud收购关停的去中心化音乐平台Nina Protocol](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/22/soundcloud-acquires-decentralized-music-platform-nina-protocol-months-after-its-shutdown/) — 艺术家、编辑档案和音乐发现工具并入SoundCloud，独立音乐市场整合加剧。
- [Science Corp视觉恢复芯片获欧盟批准](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/22/science-corporations-vision-restoring-chip-wins-eu-approval/) — CEO Max Hodak称行业需要年收入1亿美元的公司，商业化路径渐明。
- [iOS 27代码显示Apple可能推出“限制模式”管控分期付款手机](https://www.theverge.com/tech/969596/apple-restricted-mode-ios-27) — 若未按时还款，iPhone可能被限制使用，与“Apple Upgrade”租赁计划配合，引发用户权益讨论。

**收束判断**：科技产品领域正经历法律、平台和政策的多重重组：Meta暂避诉讼，微软向下兼容扩张生态，Apple探索新商业模式，脑机接口进入临床伦理考验。
科技产品.en:
Product news spanned gaming, streaming, and health tech. Lego unveiled a Donkey Kong arcade set, Steam added gifting and wishlist features, SoundCloud acquired decentralized platform Nina Protocol, and Science Corporation’s retinal implant won EU approval. Apple’s iOS 27 code hints at a new device financing program with remote lock capabilities.

- [Lego Donkey Kong arcade machine announced](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/969668/lego-donkey-kong-arcade-machine) — $200 set designed by Carl Merriam, Mario creator reportedly happy.
- [Steam updates gifting and wishlist](https://www.engadget.com/2221369/steam-adds-handy-gifting-and-wishlist-updates/) — Gift without recipient’s account, sort wishlists into categories.
- [SoundCloud acquires Nina Protocol](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/22/soundcloud-acquires-decentralized-music-platform-nina-protocol-months-after-its-shutdown/) — Brings independent artist tools and archive to SoundCloud.
- [Science Corp’s vision chip wins EU approval](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/22/science-corporations-vision-restoring-chip-wins-eu-approval/) — Retinal implant for restoring sight moves toward commercial rollout.
- [iOS 27 beta shows Restricted Mode for missed payments](https://www.theverge.com/tech/969596/apple-restricted-mode-ios-27) — Could lock down a financed iPhone if payments are late, tied to upcoming Apple Upgrade program.

Consumer tech continues to blend nostalgia, platform consolidation, and health innovation, with Apple’s financing model raising privacy and control questions.

足球.zh:
### 足球
- **卡塞米罗加盟迈阿密国际引调查**：巴西中场卡塞米罗以自由身签约迈阿密国际，但MLS随即宣布调查该俱乐部是否涉嫌违规接触球员（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c3304ex7n7xo) / [Sky](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13556097/casemiro-transfer-news-former-man-utd-midfielder-joins-inter-miami-on-free-transfer)）。这笔交易可能影响联盟规则执行。
- **萨利巴背伤缺阵**：阿森纳确认法国中卫萨利巴因世界杯期间受伤将“长期缺席”，对枪手防线打击巨大（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c5yveezg9q3o) / [Sky](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13566125/william-saliba-injury-arsenal-confirm-france-international-will-miss-extended-period-after-returning-from-world-cup-with-back-problem)）。
- **流浪者主帅上诉禁令**：德里克·麦金尼斯因抨击裁判判罚被禁赛四场，俱乐部支持其上诉（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cd694y2pezlo)）。
- **狼队训练因前锋拒绝离场取消**：前锋阿罗科达雷迫使狼队取消训练，场面一度失控（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cr5934j1jmdo)）。
- **切尔西和维拉转会博弈**：切尔西如何买得起摩根·罗杰斯？维拉为何租借加纳乔而非直接买断？两家俱乐部财务平衡引人关注（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cvg0723e0jko)）。

收束：转会市场暗流涌动，伤病与纪律问题同时冲击多支球队，英超新赛季备战变数陡增。
足球.en:
The football desk saw a mix of club-level administrative shocks and player health scares. Arsenal's William Saliba is out long-term, Wolves faced a training disruption, and Inter Miami's Casemiro deal is under investigation. Non-football stories like the World Matchplay darts incident and Phil Salt's Hundred cricket win also appear here due to RSS categorization.

- Arsenal have confirmed that defender William Saliba will miss an 'extended period' with a back injury sustained at the World Cup [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c5yveezg9q3o).
- Wolves striker Tolu Arokodare refused to leave the pitch, forcing the cancellation of a training session [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cr5934j1jmdo).
- Major League Soccer is investigating Inter Miami for tampering after they signed Casemiro from Manchester United on a free transfer [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c3304ex7n7xo).
- Darts player Cameron Menzies became unwell on stage during the World Matchplay, leading to his withdrawal [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/darts/news/12040/13566098/world-matchplay-darts-cameron-menzies-withdraws-after-becoming-unwell-on-stage-during-second-round-match-against-ross-smith).
