- Phil Salt led Welsh Fire to a six-wicket win over Southern Brave in The Hundred, ending an eight-match losing streak [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/cricket/news/12040/13566100/the-hundred-welsh-fire-snap-eight-match-losing-streak-against-southern-brave-as-phil-salt-stars-with-the-bat).

The Garnacho and Rogers transfer analysis underlines Premier League financial balancing acts, but the day's dominant narrative remains Saliba's injury and the Inter Miami tampering probe.

篮球.zh:
### 篮球
- **热火误发詹姆斯“介绍视频”**：迈阿密热火在YouTube误传勒布朗·詹姆斯的“加盟发布会”链接，尽管詹姆斯尚未决定下家，此举暗示双方接触密切（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/basketball/articles/c4gjwwny0zgo)）。
- **前CBA外援泰·劳森被捕**：媒体爆料劳森因偷窃伏特加被捕，其球员时期即有酒精依赖问题，形象再受打击（[Zhibo8](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE42dmRPejgxeXFzUVRBenk0cFN0NjBaaFdjc1dOeHhGeG1FckRVdlpyQTM4c2ZvbGpJVlpobnFhM1h0anBoNlV5N0lja0t2SFkwa2hDR3pBY2lyWlFyOTUyUWluV0ozcE8zX3FQY0tqNA)）。
- **CBA夏季联赛启东站8月开赛**：官方宣布启东站定档8月，为新赛季热身（[Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQMmtWY3V3QkNqa2ZobnV4dXdTOVo1WG1pWmRQZU9tSmdQY3hwNVZwdWhyMzRaT0E1MFc4N2dJWkxrRDB6V0lqNWppZ21qX3I4VVBsWlJWeHMyekxxVjgzVVZZRXczcHNSWGgwVWFpN1BPWDZFZjVISEJwLXBlZUVfWmNLcG0)）。

收束：詹姆斯去向悬念持续，CBA场外负面新闻与联赛筹备同步推进，篮球圈内忧外患并存。
篮球.en:
Basketball headlines were driven by free agency speculation and off-court misconduct. The Miami Heat's accidental posting of a LeBron James introductory video reignited rumors, while former CBA/NBA guard Ty Lawson was arrested. Additionally, the CBA Summer League schedule was announced.

- The Miami Heat mistakenly uploaded a YouTube video of a LeBron James 'introductory press conference', fueling speculation about his next team [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/basketball/articles/c4gjwwny0zgo).
- Former NBA and CBA guard Ty Lawson was arrested for allegedly stealing vodka; reports indicate he has struggled with alcohol dependency [Zhibo8 via Google News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE42dmRPejgxeXFzUVRBenk0cFN0NjBaaFdjc1dOeHhGeG1FckRVdlpyQTM4c2ZvbGpJVlpobnFhM1h0anBoNlV5N0lja0t2SFkwa2hDR3pBY2lyWlFyOTUyUWluV0ozcE8zX3FQY0tqNA).
- The 2026 CBA Summer League (Qidong) was announced to start in August [Sina Sports](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQMmtWY3V3QkNqa2ZobnV4dXdTOVo1WG1pWmRQZU9tSmdQY3hwNVZwdWhyMzRaT0E1MFc4N2dJWkxrRDB6V0lqNWppZ21qX3I4VVBsWlJWeHMyekxxVjgzVVZZRXczcHNSWGgwVWFpN1BPWDZFZjVISEJwLXBlZUVfWmNLcG0).

LeBron's move remains the biggest unresolved story, but Lawson's arrest casts a shadow over player conduct off the court.

羽毛球.zh:
### 羽毛球
- **李诗沣主场一轮游**：2026年中国公开赛首轮，国羽男单李诗沣1-2不敌世界排名第24的对手，遭遇爆冷出局（[新浪](https://news.google.)）。
- **王祉怡苦战逆转**：女单王祉怡在先丢一局的情况下逆转晋级，成为当日亮点（[新浪](https://news.google.) / [olympics.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxQcGdBTWx4UGYxN2Y0S21EZkR6SFl5UUVUa3pYSFo1cFZKcG14Rzl3WnAtb1lUdkliN0lzNzU4VU1uSHQtbDlkaUp1aWkzOHdpcWZyZVJuaDhFZF9yZFpaNnJxczZXRjY0cnVuQWZ0bS1aZFZYQWxHOEdydGpYZzg2M0xtd1ZiWDRoWU84)）。
- **混双两连胜**：国羽混双组合“凤凰”等连赢两场，展现技术碾压优势（[新浪](https://news.google.)）。
- **贾一凡/张殊贤爆冷出局**：女双组合同样一轮游，国羽女双深度受质疑（[olympics.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxQcGdBTWx4UGYxN2Y0S21EZkR6SFl5UUVUa3pYSFo1cFZKcG14Rzl3WnAtb1lUdkliN0lzNzU4VU1uSHQtbDlkaUp1aWkzOHdpcWZyZVJuaDhFZF9yZFpaNnJxczZXRjY0cnVuQWZ0bS1aZFZYQWxHOEdydGpYZzg2M0xtd1ZiWDRoWU84)）。

收束：国羽主场作战遭遇多场冷门，尤其男单和女双需警惕状态波动，混双则保持强势。
羽毛球.en:
The China Open badminton tournament delivered major upsets on its second day. Home favorite Li Shifeng fell in the first round, while Wang Zhiyi staged a comeback win. Mixed doubles pairs continued to dominate, and the BWF World Championships in New Delhi later this year were highlighted.

- Li Shifeng, a top Chinese men's singles player, lost 1-2 to world No. 24, exiting the China Open in the first round [Sina](https://news.google.).
- Wang Zhiyi overcame a tough match to advance in the women's singles, part of China's 7-4 record on the day [Sina](https://news.google.).
- Chinese mixed doubles pairs won two matches, overwhelming their Indian opponents with superior technique [Sina](https://news.google.).
- The BWF World Championships are scheduled for New Delhi this year, with preparation now in focus [Olympics.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxPRWpZVnhfYjhGUDRiWEFMdkR1ckVFdm1zR1RvV0RsQ2pFMHdyUkdxTjJlRFRRdVZoN0RrR3BrN2V6SHhyQ3kwUHhNemlTMnBuV3FxX3hCbEN6NXg4MENsTlktakN4NWZnS0Q3Z0lXS1ZKaWdQa1dOZ2JoQW9WRHRubEl4NTZtRDIzdnRLZTh0aDgyUm8).

Li Shifeng's early exit is a setback for Chinese badminton, but the women's and mixed doubles depth remains encouraging ahead of the World Championships.

虎扑社区动态.zh:
### 虎扑社区动态
- **金球奖或取消今年评选**：法媒称目前无领跑者，建议取消2026年金球奖，引发球迷热议（[新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxQVS04LXBFN1NUNnYwbl9uZmx0WWVLbjFTN3RJWWpyRkNEYzBPRkhyM3NXLUFlZVVDdU5rRnNRdHZBTWFiSWpYaHl4QnJ0bi1vYWJJN2g3WG9SODZCUmF5OGxJem45aUl0bFVocXJUQktQZFlvWGEwV0J5T20zVEdtWEZ3eHhoQ1BCVWUxX2ZQRWpSdw)）。
- **詹姆斯经纪人回应去向**：里奇·保罗表示詹姆斯不会因联盟施压而仓促决定，强调等待时机（[MSN](https://news.google.)）。
- **塔图姆与哈利伯顿合练**：凯尔特人球星分享训练照，球迷期待新赛季表现（[MSN](https://news.google.)）。
- **JR评詹姆斯巅峰**：JR认为13热火詹比18骑士詹更恐怖，统治力更强（[MSN](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-)）。
- **圣枪哥或加入BLG轮换**：电竞转会传闻同样搅动虎扑社区（[新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE0xWHdURU9XR1VLRkd5clV4NEtKTXlOcGZ0QkNESUlBNnhNWTFwb2Fqbm1WcmYtT0NpdDlyQ1FfQXMyQ2RtOHVVOHlodlpQN3VzVlJYWmo3eHByOHg4ZmN5Y01DUQ)）。

收束：虎扑社区围绕金球奖争议、詹姆斯去向、球星训练等话题持续发酵，反映了球迷对当下体育热点的多元讨论。
虎扑社区动态.en:
Tiger Pounce community saw a lively mix of NBA offseason chatter, historical comparisons, and even esports speculation. Users discussed LeBron James' free agency, with Rich Paul saying he won't rush, and a comparison of 2013 Heat LeBron vs. 2018 Cavs LeBron. Summer League stats for Lakers' signing and a potential BLG roster change in League of Legends also emerged.

- Rich Paul, LeBron James' agent, stated the star won't be hurried into a decision despite pressure from NBA commissioner Silver [MSN](https://news.google.).
- A user-posted analysis by former NBA player JR Smith claimed that LeBron's 2013 Heat version was 'more terrifying' and laid the foundation for his dominance [MSN](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-).
- A Lakers beat reporter praised the signing of undrafted summer league star Kaluma, who averaged 19 points per game [MSN](https://news.google.).
- A rumor surfaced that professional esports player 'Saint Gun' might join BLG as a substitute in a League of Legends roster shake-up [Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE0xWHdURU9XR1VLRkd5clV4NEtKTXlOcGZ0QkNESUlBNnhNWTFwb2Fqbm1WcmYtT0NpdDlyQ1FfQXMyQ2RtOHVVOHlodlpQN3VzVlJYWmo3eHByOHg4ZmN5Y01DUQ).
- A user noted that Paris Saint-Germain's Fabián Ruiz became the first player to remain unbeaten in his first 50 international appearances [MSN](https://news.google.).

The community mood centers on LeBron's next move and nostalgic NBA comparisons, with esports and international football records adding variety.

日韩.zh: 今日韩剧选角动态密集：南柱赫一口气接下两部题材迥异的新作——《Lovely Runner》编剧执笔的浪漫剧[《Heartbeat》](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856919wpp/nam-joo-hyuk-confirmed-for-new-romance-drama-by-lovely-runner-writer)和迪士尼+悬疑犯罪剧[《Code》](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856893wpp/nam-joo-hyuk-lee-yi-dam-and-more-confirmed-for-new-mystery-crime-drama-code)，艺人工作强度与作品质量平衡值得关注。李俊昊搭档洪花妍确认出演tvN新剧[《韩国怪兽使馆》](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856891wpp/lee-junho-and-hong-hwa-yeon-confirmed-for-new-rom-com-drama)，神秘浪漫喜剧设定新颖。此外，《Agent Kim Reactivated》剧组获[奖励旅行](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856815wpp/agent-kim-reactivated-cast-and-crew-reportedly-going-on-reward-vacation-agencies-respond)，SHINee泰民通过[神秘预告](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856850wpp/watch-shinees-taemin-hints-at-comeback-with-mysterious-teaser)暗示今秋回归。Dragon Pony成员Pyun Sunghyun因健康原因[暂停活动](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856847wpp/dragon-ponys-pyun-sunghyun-to-go-on-hiatus-band-to-promote-as-3-member-group-for-time-being)。整体看，下半年韩剧阵容竞争激烈，且偶像跨界影视与回归并行。
日韩.en:
The Korean entertainment industry is bustling with casting confirmations and drama updates. Nam Joo Hyuk is the star of the day, confirmed for both a romance drama by the 'Lovely Runner' writer and a mystery crime thriller 'Code' for Disney+. Meanwhile, Lee Junho and Hong Hwa Yeon will headline tvN's upcoming rom-com 'Embassy for Foreign Monsters in Korea,' and the action revenge drama 'Agent Kim Reactivated' continues to gain traction with a planned reward vacation for its cast.

- **Nam Joo Hyuk's Double Duty**: He will lead 'Heartbeat' (romance) and 'Code' (crime), showcasing versatility. ([Soompi romance](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856919wpp/nam-joo-hyuk-confirmed-for-new-romance-drama-by-lovely-runner-writer), [Soompi crime](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856893wpp/nam-joo-hyuk-lee-yi-dam-and-more-confirmed-for-new-mystery-crime-drama-code))
- **Lee Junho & Hong Hwa Yeon's Rom-Com**: tvN's 'Embassy for Foreign Monsters in Korea' adds a supernatural twist to romance. ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856891wpp/lee-junho-and-hong-hwa-yeon-confirmed-for-new-rom-com-drama))
- **'Agent Kim Reactivated' Success**: So Ji Sub's drama is going strong, with the cast and crew reportedly heading to Guam for a reward trip. ([Soompi reward](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856815wpp/agent-kim-reactivated-cast-and-crew-reportedly-going-on-reward-vacation-agencies-respond), [Soompi new mission](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856935wpp/so-ji-sub-choi-dae-hoon-and-yoon-kyung-ho-embark-on-a-new-mission-in-agent-kim-reactivated))
- **Taemin Teases Comeback**: SHINee's Taemin dropped a mysterious teaser for a fall album, generating fan excitement. ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856850wpp/watch-shinees-taemin-hints-at-comeback-with-mysterious-teaser))
- **Black Comedy 'The Affair Was Just the Beginning'**: New trailers show Kim Hye Soo and cast in a dangerous entanglement. ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856867wpp/watch-kim-hye-soo-kim-ji-hun-cho-yeo-jeong-and-more-are-dangerously-entangled-in-cheeky-trailers-for-the-affair-was-just-the-beginning))

**Signal**: The 日韩 desk is a hotbed of new projects; watch for casting announcements to drive early buzz for 2027 lineups.

欧美.zh: 《奥德赛》的胜利延续至舆论场：Whoopi Goldberg在《The View》中[怒怼保守派批评](https://deadline.com/2026/07/whoopi-goldberg-slams-critics-elliot-page-the-odyssey-1237000954/)，Travis Scott分享[首次演戏的紧张](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/travis-scott-christopher-nolan-the-odyssey-acting-nerves-1236654348/)，4DX体验报道[制造话题](https://variety.com/2026/film/features/the-odyssey-4dx-moving-seats-water-spraying-1236818539/)。MCU方面，Kevin Feige首次明确[Miles Morales将入局](https://deadline.com/2026/07/kevin-feige-wants-add-miles-morales-mcu-after-spider-verse-1237000938/)，时间点选在索尼动画三部曲结束后。幕后变动：Reid Scott离开《法律与秩序》，James Badge Dale接棒；Tom Holland透露[Fred Astaire传记片](https://deadline.com/2026/07/tom-holland-shares-fred-astaire-biopic-update-1237000837/)进展，计划用长镜头拍摄舞戏。此外，Paramount与WBD的合并案因加州总检察长起诉而[遭遇临时禁令](https://deadline.com/2026/07/paramount-warner-bros-state-attorney-general-lawsuit-1237000888/)，好莱坞格局再添变数。
欧美.en:
Hollywood is in a phase of franchise expansion and personnel shifts. Kevin Feige's confirmation that Miles Morales will enter the MCU after the Spider-Verse trilogy ends marks a major long-term plan for Sony and Marvel. The box office juggernaut 'The Odyssey' continues to dominate, while behind-the-scenes changes at 'Law & Order' and the expansion of Yeon Sang-ho's 'Parasyte' universe signal ongoing evolution in TV and streaming content.

- **Miles Morales MCU Plans**: Kevin Feige states 'We definitely have plans' for a live-action Miles Morales, leveraging the end of the animated Spider-Verse. ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/kevin-feige-wants-add-miles-morales-mcu-after-spider-verse-1237000938/))
- **Whoopi Goldberg Defends 'The Odyssey' Casting**: On The View, Goldberg slammed transphobic critics of Elliot Page's role, as the film surpasses $300M. ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/whoopi-goldberg-slams-critics-elliot-page-the-odyssey-1237000954/))
- **Reid Scott Exits 'Law & Order'**: James Badge Dale will replace him in Season 26, a notable casting shift for the veteran NBC drama. ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/reid-scott-leaving-law-order-james-badge-dale-season-26-nbc-1237000929/))
- **Yeon Sang-ho's 'Parasyte: Tamiya'**: Netflix confirms a new live-action series starring Shioli Kutsuna, set for 2027, expanding the Parasyte universe. ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/yeon-sang-ho-parasyte-tamiya-shioli-kutsuna-netflix-1236817846/), [THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/netflix-yeon-sang-ho-parasyte-tamiya-series-1236653812/))
- **Tom Holland's Fred Astaire Biopic Update**: The actor wants to film dance sequences as oners, honoring Astaire's style, while promoting multiple major projects. ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/tom-holland-shares-fred-astaire-biopic-update-1237000837/))

**Signal**: The intersection of IP expansion (Miles Morales, Parasyte) and talent turnover (Law & Order) suggests a dynamic period for Hollywood; box office performance of 'The Odyssey' will influence future epic releases.

微博社区动态.zh: 今日微博娱乐热搜被演员角色互动和偶发趣事占据。李昀锐在飞机上玩“空姐玩具”的视频[意外爆红](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE1UbDRhQUFYemtiREI1VkN5ZUhRWGhDaDFrMHlubTdIV2dCc2dReVk4M3pEdFI0YXU2cHJfQmxSTF9kclRRREkzb214RGtSNnNlYlBtWVNhVHJaUXlIREUwdUlEd20zeUpvLXlWU3pXeEI)，衍生出品牌、型号等二次搜索话题，反差萌圈粉明显。王楚然回复张凌赫互动被网友调侃[“不像剧宣像官宣”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTFB0Mm4zblhhN2drN05Wd2lpWDQxUkJmSTl2aEM1ZU5Eem4zMjZnZDEzWkRuU2ttRVM4SVBlNDZFTmdYWFRDMlZUVElWN3NYbVVKaUZZNFZlT0xjLUgwQ1RyVG9WWEduNkpDb3VCMVA4cUI)，为《这一秒过火》带来高热关注。另外，陈妍希以观众身份发视频引付辛博回应，鞠婧祎民国造型[引发全网热议](https://news.google.)。整体呈现“轻量级话题带动高互动”特征，娱乐化营销效果显著。
微博社区动态.en:
Chinese social media is alive with celebrity gossip and viral moments. Actor Li Yunrui's playful in-flight toy video sparked widespread curiosity and a brand hunt, while Wang Churan's role interactions with Zhang Linghe fueled shipping speculation. Meanwhile, Ju Jingyi's Republic-era styling and table tennis star Sun Yingsha's food delivery recommendation also trended. The buzz around these micro-events shows how even small celebrity actions can dominate the Weibo trending list.

- **Li Yunrui's Toy Frenzy**: The actor played with a 'stress relief bird' toy on a plane, leading to multiple articles identifying the brand and praising his 'contrast charm'. ([brand](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTFA4WjBTenlwVGlJTHZfelhiYTk1bFd3bk9HS2xxcktvVTVyOHgtZUZEd1E3U1hmQW1JQ0xFM1lVWHhxUlFVWThxeU91QzZ1emVpQW9UNVBEM0prMVFUZEllY1FPMV9uSFQtUVdWN3ZGclQ), [reaction](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTFB0Wmw4d3J0NHFNMWVrU3loV2lYWEQ4Rk16QjQwdEREVXV0WVhfNzZoQnlELUh5SjVzUUtkQ2lWYVdJYWpjeU83MGpYSTFvUzZVZ3Nxb1h0WGo4cHJ4ejlReDhJb1E5RTBZcktBcHNsdXI))
- **Wang Churan and Zhang Linghe's Chemistry**: The actress's reply to Zhang was described as 'not like drama promotion, like an official announcement,' boosting attention for the drama 'This Second Overheats.' ([interaction](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTFB0Mm4zblhhN2drN05Wd2lpWDQxUkJmSTl2aEM1ZU5Eem4zMjZnZDEzWkRuU2ttRVM4SVBlNDZFTmdYWFRDMlZUVElWN3NYbVVKaUZZNFZlT0xjLUgwQ1RyVG9WWEduNkpDb3VCMVA4cUI), [impact](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE5IamFieFFQaTdXQ2d4VWJ1YTZDcjZKUjBzUDBpZ1ZjNWprT2lhNnBVT2NxTlBwU1FkSDZaX21RaUlZNHhfUnE3WmxsYVRORmpzMFJGTHNUbXNyOUxucnozWmZKRURsYUJSeGN3TEpvbjU))
- **Ju Jingyi's Republic Era Look**: The singer's styling became a hot topic, driven by visual appeal and nostalgia. ([Sina](https://news.google.))
- **Sun Yingsha Recommends Takeout Platform**: The Olympic table tennis champion's casual Weibo post about a food delivery app went viral, showing the influence of sports stars on consumer behavior. ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE9FUEVMSDI3dVRvOHlzN3hIQjNNNjNHaGRmLVZ0YnVLSy02WlZDZjBwamw0VGJ4SmtsQUQzTl9SdlhWVEtIWlk5dnFEcEREeHcwVFBSWUJTWi0wQWNTLVJwNlpDT1pZbG9xQ3BIUENpckprZw))
- **Chen Yanxi and Fu Xinbo's Exchange**: Chen's video as a 'regular audience' prompted a response from Fu, sparking curiosity about their relationship. ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE1LYmNaQ2FtbDFQUldmaUhsWWYwUk01ejN4czhSNlVVVTNMMWZNZy1DSDRQTXVTOGc2T2txN0F2RGtVMEJlV2Y4NXlDOEFtd0pjZmRmeHJHLTk0QWM1S3J1Yk5ONklqSDBHZmVwWWJ1RV95dw))

**Signal**: Weibo's entertainment ecosystem remains highly reactive to personal moments; brands should watch for organic product placements like Li Yunrui's toy.

中国.zh: 当日中国娱乐新闻呈现冰火两重天。火的一面：China GT超级跑车锦标赛因郭富城、吴彦祖、韩东君等明星参与，导致[现场秩序失控](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE45cWo5eGRWUTZPNDZWQ2lCZjY2YkZOdmdzandTVEJIcnVjdERtZVdyNkVGa3ZtRU5tUTBtMEhQQllwYWRaLVFQREJ6RlBSRkpfelJxbzI0ZTJIcjQ)，闫闯、韩路发文批评并登上热搜，暴露赛事管理短板；Netflix韩剧《鬼迷东宫》被指[挪用中国古风](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE9TVjlOOVFZUkpPV3ZEQVNObkc5d0o5R3pBRHlOT3NpM2VpMndQTTNwWFhpVGVTdW5jZkhScXdtWC14eFpzMmt4S3dBWDhBNTR2RXlHbWlwZlJsRW92X0RqV1g3UjNQSGFrbU9WbEZvbXE)，再度引发文化挪用争议。冰的一面：赵又廷在采访中直呼[“电影已经没了”](https://news.google.)，呼应“影视寒冬”系列报道；彭于晏新剧难产亦是力证。此外，SNH48[夏季活动](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE5hTk9obWRxdHZ6endjUUtvellnamhseUdWNDl4TFBEOUlvSHV4V1RBcC16bWZ0RG5udmVFMTJueXVDZE84anE0dmJKcllqUzRRbEdFQXFxQXE3WTA)如期举行，但整体行业下行趋势明显。
中国.en:
The Chinese entertainment industry is navigating a pronounced downturn, with Mark Chao and Eddie Peng openly lamenting a 'film winter' and advising against entering the business. At the same time, star participation in the China GT supercar race caused on-site chaos, and a Netflix Korean drama 'Ghostly East Palace' is accused of misappropriating Chinese historical aesthetics. Meanwhile, foreign audiences are increasingly discussing Chinese cultural customs through C-dramas, highlighting a growing global footprint despite domestic struggles.

- **Film Winter Confirmed**: Mark Chao stated 'movies are gone' and discouraged his daughter from following his path; Eddie Peng's new drama is reportedly stalled. ([Sin Chew](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE9uUXpEb3hlbVRUZlktZFNQdFhLdnRMbFM2Z3Znb1dySHhNR042TDZDTl9TOENHejZheFFrN0d6TlZzZm1EeGZKUDJzX0NueUFvS1ZubWlGN2dPcnBaeFphblVkTWNtNWFUVE5Oa0tkbw), [China Press](https://news.google.))
- **China GT Crowd Chaos**: Stars like Aaron Kwok and Daniel Wu caused fan frenzy at the supercar race, leading to disorder that trended on Weibo. ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBIM0RlMVhCMWdaQm1OemYzdDB0bmctQlpsakQ1WUo3YVM2WUhVSkZsclcyeERwUXAwa3ZrYVk4T09WUzc3T01taWZnOHp6S0lOV2xrMXUxeHY3Qllqb3V4b1h0QQ), [autohome](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE45cWo5eGRWUTZPNDZWQ2lCZjY2YkZOdmdzandTVEJIcnVjdERtZVdyNkVGa3ZtRU5tUTBtMEhQQllwYWRaLVFQREJ6RlBSRkpfelJxbzI0ZTJIcjQ))
- **Netflix Drama Accused of Cultural Appropriation**: 'Ghostly East Palace' is criticized for using Chinese ancient aesthetics without acknowledgment, sparking nationalist backlash. ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE9TVjlOOVFZUkpPV3ZEQVNObkc5d0o5R3pBRHlOT3NpM2VpMndQTTNwWFhpVGVTdW5jZkhScXdtWC14eFpzMmt4S3dBWDhBNTR2RXlHbWlwZlJsRW92X0RqV1g3UjNQSGFrbU9WbEZvbXE))
